descriptionHtml:
Head of AI Transformation

Location: London, United Kingdom (Preferred)

Type: Full-Time | Hybrid or Onsite

About Humanoid

Humanoid is a next-generation humanoid robotics company building safe, reliable, and cost-effective robotic systems for industrial environments.

As we scale globally, we believe artificial intelligence will become a foundational capability across every aspect of the company—from engineering and manufacturing to finance, supply chain, compliance, and executive decision-making.

To accelerate this vision, Humanoid is establishing an AI-First Operating Model that embeds AI into the core of how the company works, learns, innovates, and continuously improves.

We are seeking an exceptional Head of AI Transformation to lead this company-wide transformation and help shape the future of Humanoid as an AI-native organization.

About the Role

The Head of AI Transformation will be responsible for defining and executing Humanoid's enterprise-wide AI transformation strategy.

This leader will establish the vision, operating model, governance framework, and execution roadmap required to enable AI adoption across all business functions. Working closely with the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Business Transformation, IT, Engineering, and functional leaders, you will drive Humanoid's evolution into an AI-native company.

You will lead the AI Transformation Office and oversee a cross-functional team, including AI Leads across Engineering, Business Operations, Back Office Functions, and Executive Operations. You will ensure that every AI initiative delivers measurable business value while maintaining the highest standards of security, compliance, governance, and operational excellence.

This is a highly strategic leadership role with significant influence over the future operating model of the company.

Key Responsibilities

AI Transformation Strategy

  • Define and execute Humanoid's enterprise AI transformation vision and roadmap.
  • Develop a company-wide AI strategy aligned with business objectives and growth plans.
  • Establish priorities, investment frameworks, and governance structures for AI initiatives.
  • Advise executive leadership on emerging AI opportunities, risks, and market developments.
  • Build an AI-first culture focused on innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive the adoption of AI agents, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled workflows across the organization.

AI Operating Model & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and evolve Humanoid's AI-Powered Continuous Improvement Flywheel.
  • Establish transformation governance, operating cadences, reporting mechanisms, and executive review forums.
  • Embed AI initiatives into business planning, capability maturity assessments, and operational reviews.
  • Identify, prioritize, and scale high-impact AI use cases across all functions.
  • Ensure successful pilots are translated into enterprise-wide capabilities.
  • Drive the development of AI-native ways of working across the organization.

Enterprise AI Governance

  • Establish policies, standards, and controls for responsible AI deployment.
  • Define governance frameworks covering:
  • AI ethics and responsible AI
  • Security and cyber risk management
  • Data governance and privacy
  • Human-in-the-loop controls
  • Model evaluation and monitoring
  • Compliance and audit readiness
  • AI vendor and platform governance
  • Ensure all AI solutions align with corporate, legal, and regulatory requirements.

Organizational Transformation & Change Management

  • Lead enterprise-wide AI adoption and change management programs.
  • Build AI literacy across leadership teams and employee populations.
  • Establish AI Champions networks and communities of practice.
  • Drive workforce enablement and behavioral change initiatives.
  • Foster a culture where AI augments human capabilities, accelerates decision-making, and improves productivity.

Business Impact & Value Realization

  • Define KPIs and success metrics for AI transformation initiatives.
  • Measure and report:
  • Automation maturity
  • Productivity improvements
  • ROI of AI initiatives
  • User adoption
  • Quality and accuracy outcomes
  • Cost efficiencies
  • Operational performance improvements
  • Present transformation progress, outcomes, and strategic recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team and Board.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead and mentor AI Leads and transformation teams across the business.
  • Partner closely with:
  • CEO and Executive Leadership Team
  • Business Transformation
  • Engineering
  • IT
  • Finance
  • HR
  • Supply Chain
  • Compliance
  • Cybersecurity
  • Align AI initiatives across functions to avoid duplication and maximize business impact.
  • Promote collaboration between technical and business teams.

Innovation & External Ecosystem

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, and market developments.
  • Build relationships with AI vendors, research institutions, industry partners, and startups.
  • Identify opportunities to create competitive advantage through AI.
  • Benchmark Humanoid against leading AI-native organizations and establish best practices.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in business transformation, digital transformation, enterprise technology, AI strategy, or AI leadership roles.
  • Proven track record leading large-scale organizational transformation programs.
  • Deep understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI systems, automation, and enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience designing enterprise operating models, governance frameworks, and transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of business process transformation and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving business, technology, and operations teams.
  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical, strategic, and systems-thinking capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate emerging technologies into measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience building AI adoption programs at enterprise scale.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI Centers of Excellence (CoE) or enterprise AI programs.
  • Experience deploying AI agents and intelligent automation solutions at scale.
  • Background in robotics, advanced manufacturing, industrial automation, or deep-tech organizations.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, capability maturity frameworks, and operational excellence methodologies.
  • Experience with enterprise knowledge management and AI-driven decision support systems.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Established Humanoid's AI Transformation Office and governance framework.
  • Embedded AI maturity assessments into business capability reviews.
  • Delivered multiple AI initiatives with measurable business impact.
  • Built and operationalized an AI-first operating model across engineering and business functions.
  • Increased automation maturity across critical value streams.
  • Improved productivity through AI-enabled workflows and intelligent automation.
  • Created a sustainable AI adoption culture supported by governance, training, and continuous improvement.
  • Positioned Humanoid as one of the world's leading AI-native robotics companies.

descriptionHtml:
Bravura’s Commitment and Mission

At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.

As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.

Role Purpose

Lead the enterprise-wide adoption of AI across the business, shaping how AI is applied across products, systems and processes. The role is focused on identifying high-value use cases, driving adoption, and embedding AI ways of working across the organisation. This is a transformation role, with responsibility for establishing the operating model, governance and behaviours required to scale AI effectively over a multi-year horizon.

The role may also explore how AI can be embedded within our products to enhance client experience and operational efficiency.

Role Responsibilities

This is a CEO-sponsored, business-critical role operating across all functions. The role will initially be standalone, requiring influence across senior stakeholders rather than direct team ownership.


  • Define and lead the enterprise AI strategy across products, systems and internal functions
  • Identify and prioritise high-value AI use cases, focusing on measurable business impact
  • Drive adoption of AI across the organisation, embedding practical usage into day-to-day workflows
  • Establish the operating model, governance and guardrails for responsible AI use
  • Deliver early wins while building a scalable, long-term approach to AI adoption
  • Influence and challenge senior stakeholders across Product and business units to align on priorities
  • Build internal capability through training, tooling and best practice sharing
  • Partner with IT, Security and Risk to ensure compliant and sustainable implementation
  • Track and communicate progress, outcomes and ROI at executive level
  • Identify opportunities to embed AI within products (e.g., client migration, data mapping, or documentation automation).


Key Skills & Qualifications


  • Senior product, data, or operations leader with experience driving enterprise wide transformation, AI or automation initiatives
  • Track record of delivering measurable business impact through AI, digital or process transformation
  • Demonstrated success deploying generative AI or automation tools in enterprise settings
  • Strong understanding of workflow design and change management
  • Strong understanding of how to move from experimentation to scaled adoption across an organisation
  • Comfortable engaging technical and non-technical teams to translate ideas into measurable results
  • Proven ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders
  • Experience of leading transformation across multiple functions rather than within a single domain
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery of outcomes
  • Can measure success through adoption and impact rather than activity


Working at Bravura

Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.

So, what’s next?

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.

Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.

All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, AI & Data Strategy - Technical Product Management for Responsible AI - Commercialization

As a Director level Technical Product Manager for Responsible AI within the AI Governance team, you will lead the transformation of internal Responsible AI capabilities into customer-ready products and consulting offerings. Your mandate is to productionize Responsible AI tooling so it is scalable, supportable, robust, and packaged into an offering for global enterprise firms in highly regulated industries.

You will own the technical product direction for Responsible AI platforms while also providing solution architecture leadership to ensure Responsible AI expectations translate into deployable, auditable, and commercially viable solutions. This role operates at the intersection of engineering, governance, and go to market execution.

You will partner closely with internal AI, platform, legal, compliance, and consulting teams and possibly externally with customers, regulators, and ecosystem partners to shape repeatable Responsible AI products and services that can be delivered consistently across jurisdictions and infrastructure environments.

Role Overview

This role combines technical product management, solution architecture, and commercialization leadership for Responsible AI capabilities.

As the Technical Product Owner

You are accountable for converting internal Responsible AI tooling into adoption ready and market facing offerings. This includes defining product boundaries, maturity standards, documentation, service offerings and ongoing success required for client deployment . You balance governance rigor with usability, scalability, and delivery feasibility.

As the Solution Shaping Architect

You work early with customers, regulators, and delivery teams to define end to end Responsible AI solutions that operate within real world constraints such as cloud, on premises, sovereign, and hybrid environments and that align with regulatory, contractual, and operational expectations.

You lead through influence by aligning engineering, governance, legal, compliance, and delivery teams to make decisions under ambiguity and ensure Responsible AI products can be sold, deployed, operated, and maintained at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Product Management Responsible AI Commercialization

Collaborate with internal teams to define the productization strategy for Responsible AI tooling, evolving internal platforms and prototypes into sellable products or consulting accelerators.

Define and manage technical product requirements including epics, acceptance criteria, and dependencies with an explicit focus on external usability, operability, and governance defensibility.

Establish product standards for commercial readiness including documentation, audit evidence, configuration guidance, versioning, and support and operating models.

Translate complex data science and Responsible AI concepts into clear client ready value propositions and provide precise direction to engineering teams.

Track outcomes and adoption signals to identify when Responsible AI tools or services require refinement, modularization, repositioning, or retirement.

Solution Architecture Deployable and Client Ready Responsible AI

Engage directly with customers, government agencies, regulators, and partners to understand deployment environments, security models, regulatory requirements, and operational constraints.

Design end to end Responsible AI by design systems that integrate data pipelines, models or large language models, orchestration layers, APIs, monitoring, human oversight, and documentation.

Translate governance and regulatory expectations into implementable system designs with clear operational controls, accountability, and evidence generation.

Define and promote reusable reference architectures, architectural patterns, and delivery playbooks that support repeatable client implementations.

Partner with privacy, security, and governance teams to ensure solutions are approval-ready and defensible during regulatory scrutiny, audits, and client due diligence.

Provide architectural guidance, design intent, and decision rationale to delivery teams responsible for implementation and client rollout.

Go to Market Enablement and Stakeholder Leadership

Partner with commercial, consulting, and delivery teams to ensure Responsible AI offerings are clearly scoped, repeatable, and scalable.

Advise stakeholders on trade offs across risk, scalability, explainability, delivery effort, and long term operational burden in client environments.

Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by bridging policy intent, technical feasibility, and commercial execution.

Drive alignment across engineering, governance, legal, compliance, and operations teams and resolve conflicts to enable execution without formal authority.

All About You

Must Have

A strong academic background in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience.

Hands on experience building, testing, approving, and deploying data science or AI systems including post deployment lifecycle management.

Demonstrated success delivering production grade AI platforms or tooling intended for external use.

Experience working directly with external stakeholders such as customers, government agencies, regulators, vendors, or systems integrators.

Proven ability to operate in ambiguous environments, drive decisions through influence, and communicate clearly with both technical and non technical audiences.

Technical Skills

Experience building or scaling Responsible AI or AI governance tooling for external use.

Experience designing or integrating governance capabilities including monitoring, documentation, approval workflows, and lifecycle controls.

An understanding of the responsible AI marketplace and key products within the domain

Long term work eligibility for Singapore.

Preferred

Understanding of Python, SQL, and modern machine learning platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, or SageMaker.

Experience contributing to centers of excellence, platform teams, or internal capability building initiatives that support multiple business units or clients.

Internal Responsible AI tools successfully transformed into adoption ready and client deployable products or consulting accelerators.

Clear product roadmaps and maturity models that support repeatable delivery at scale.

Successful deployment of Responsible AI solutions across diverse customer infrastructure environments.

Reuse of Responsible AI reference architectures, architectural patterns, and delivery playbooks across engagements and regions.

Increased confidence in the organization’s ability to operationalize Responsible AI commercially.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

descriptionHtml:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

Working within EMEA Corporate Technology, EMEA TEC, as Head of Applied AI to lead the strategy, build-out, socialisation, and operationalisation of applied AI capabilities. This is a senior leadership role responsible for translating AI potential into measurable business outcomes, spanning multiple business areas.

NUMBER OF DIRECT REPORTS

TBD

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

AI Vision & Strategy:

  • Define and own the EMEA Technology Applied AI strategy, aligned to MUFG's global technology and business priorities.
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritise AI opportunities across the division.
  • Ensure the vision and strategy are articulated across the region, and the wider MUFG group.

Organisational Build-Out & Leadership:

  • Build and develop Applied AI as a core organisational capability within the EMEA Technology function.
  • Establish operating models, delivery frameworks, and career pathways that attract and retain top AI talent.
  • Foster a culture of rigorous experimentation, rapid productization, and clear business accountability.

Applied AI Delivery

  • Oversee the design and delivery of production AI systems - agentic workflows, LLM-powered co-pilots, ML inference pipelines, embedded into live front-office operations.
  • Ensure solutions integrate seamlessly with core systems and existing architectures.
  • Drive the transition from proof-of-concept to scalable, enterprise-grade deployment with measurable adoption and impact.

Data & Platform Strategy

  • Own the Applied AI platform strategy, including real-time data pipelines, ML feature stores, model registries, and agentic runtime and control plane infrastructure.
  • Partner with relevant teams and stakeholders to ensure a coherent, governed AI foundation.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Accountable for AI model governance across the division - ensuring all systems meet regulatory standards for explainability, auditability, and bias prevention.
  • Engage proactively with market risk, legal, compliance, audit and other relevant teams on model risk frameworks and emerging regulatory obligations.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with line of business heads, desk leads, and senior stakeholders across EMEA and globally.
  • Translate complex AI capabilities into compelling business cases and executive narratives.
  • Act as an external face for MUFG's AI ambition - engaging with vendors, regulators, and the broader FinTech ecosystem where relevant.
  • Partner closely with business, transformation, and control function stakeholders to shape and enable the firm’s broader DX/AI, ensuring Applied AI capabilities are aligned, integrated, and delivered in a cohesive, enterprise-wide manner

Key outcomes:

  • A clearly articulated Applied AI strategy with executive alignment and a funded, sequenced roadmap.
  • AI capabilities embedded in daily workflows across multiple business areas, and across the Technology function, with measurable adoption and business impact.
  • A high-performing, stable AI team recognised as a centre of excellence within MUFG and the broader market.
  • A governed, scalable AI platform that meets enterprise architecture, regulatory, and risk requirements.

Personal Requirements

  • Significant experience senior leadership roles within financial services; significant experience in AI, or data science technology.
  • Proven track record building and scaling applied AI functions within global markets, capital markets, or institutional financial services.
  • Familiarity with core trading and banking infrastructure including Murex and ION, payment systems, core banking platforms and the integration challenges of deploying AI within regulated market systems.
  • Strong command of modern AI capabilities: LLMs, agentic frameworks, RAG, ML inference, and MLOps, sufficient to lead technical teams and challenge engineering decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive AI adoption at scale, navigating organisational complexity, change management, and business stakeholder alignment.
  • Exceptional executive communication: able to set vision, build consensus, and represent AI strategy at board and regulatory level.
  • Results driven, with a strong sense of accountability
  • The ability to operate with urgency and prioritise work accordingly
  • Strong decision making skills and sound judgement
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Strong numerical and problem solving skills
  • Creative and innovative; comfortable challenging the status quo and pushing for change
  • Excellent leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire a team

We are open to considering flexible working requests in line with organisational requirements.

MUFG is committed to embracing diversity and building an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We support the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion in recruitment and employment, and oppose all forms of discrimination on the grounds of age, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy and maternity, race, gender reassignment, religion or belief and marriage or civil partnership.

We make our recruitment decisions in a non-discriminatory manner in accordance with our commitment to identifying the right skills for the right role and our obligations under the law.

descriptionHtml:
Inception creates the world’s fastest, most efficient AI models. Our Mercury model is the world’s fastest reasoning LLM and first commercially available diffusion LLM, delivering 5x greater speed and efficiency than today’s LLMs, with best-in-class quality.


We are the AI researchers and engineers behind such breakthrough AI technologies as diffusion models, flash attention, and DPO.


The Role

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and working closely with the founding team, this role provides an opportunity to own and define Inception’s product direction. As the Head of Product Management, you'll synthesize customer needs, ecosystem trends, and breakthrough AI research into products that transform how millions of users work, create, and solve problems.


This role requires a leader who’s comfortable driving innovation in uncharted territory, where the very nature of what's possible with AI is being redefined every day.


The ideal candidate is a data‑driven, customer‑centric product builder who operates comfortably at the intersection of advanced AI research and pragmatic product delivery. They have shipped 0→1 products, scaled 1→N, and are credible with highly technical teams. They bring strong judgment in fast‑changing environments, communicate crisply with executives and partners, and can translate subtle user needs into instant‑speed experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end product lifecycle from strategy through launch
  • Conduct user research and analyze performance metrics specific to AI model behaviors and map these onto emerging use cases
  • Lead cross‑functional execution across Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Go-to-Market teams.
  • Help design evaluation systems and live benchmarks to track and improve speed and quality in target use cases
  • Set performance targets that connect model capabilities to user needs.
  • Partner with early customers to prove value in target use cases and convert pilots into repeatable product bets.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Extensive track record of driving product initiatives in rapidly changing technical landscapes and translating large and diverse sets of feature requests and feedback into product feature definitions
  • Comfortable reading and writing code: able to prototype, explore APIs, and work closely with engineering teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience conducting user research and interviews
  • Deep knowledge of LLMs at the modeling or application layer
  • Experience working in a startup and scaling products from early stage to growth phase


Compensation

The annual base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $350,000 USD. Final compensation is determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. Equity and benefits are included in the total package.


Why Join Inception

  • Work with World-Class Talent: Collaborate with the inventors of diffusion models and leading AI researchers
  • Shape Foundational Technology: Your decisions will influence how the next generation of AI products are built and used
  • Immediate Impact: Join at the ground floor where your contributions directly shape product direction and company trajectory


Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity in a rapidly growing startup
  • Flexible vacation and paid time off (PTO)
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401k match
  • Catered meals (breakfast, lunch, & dinner)
  • Commuter subsidies
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture


About Us

Inception creates the world’s fastest, most efficient AI models. Today’s autoregressive LLMs generate tokens sequentially, which makes them painfully slow and expensive. Inception’s diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs) generate answers in parallel. They are 5x faster and more efficient, while delivering best-in-class quality.


Inception was co-founded by Stanford professor Stefano Ermon, who co-invented such breakthrough AI technologies as diffusion models, flash attention, and DPO, UCLA professor Aditya Grover, who co-invented node2vec, decision transformers, and d1 reasoning, and Cornell professor and Afresh co-founder Volodymyr Kuleshov, who co-invented MDLM and Block Diffusion.


We pioneered the application of diffusion to language, with world’s first (and only) commercially available dLLM, Mercury. We are currently deploying our large-scale diffusion LLMs at Fortune 500 companies. Diffusion is the technology behind today’s image and video AI, and we’re making it the standard for LLMs as well.


Our team includes engineers from AWS, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, Microsoft, HashiCorp, and OpenAI. Based in Palo Alto, CA, we are backed by top-tier venture capitalists, including Menlo Ventures, Mayfield, M12 (Microsoft’s venture fund), Snowflake Ventures, Databricks, and Innovation Endeavors, and by tech luminaries such as Andrew Ng, Andrej Karpathy, and Eric Schmidt.


If you are talented, innovative, and ambitious, come help us invent the future of AI.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

descriptionHtml:
Hello!

At MBC we keep growing and are now looking for an AI Product Lead.

About MBC

May Business Consulting is an international consultancy firm offering expert guidance in digital transformation, change management, efficiency, and control. We are fully client-focused and engage proactively to maximize the value we deliver.

We have offices in Spain and the United Kingdom.

We work on international projects with financial institutions, fintechs, and startups.

About The Role

Our client is moving from individual Copilot use to a shared AI capability — the Brain. The AI Product Lead is the person who decides what we build, in what order, and against which business outcome. They sit between the executive ask and the technical build, and own the use-case selection process from candidate inventory through to deployment.

This is not a delivery PM role. It is a product role with enough technical and architectural depth to challenge engineers on build-vs-buy, to read a model evaluation, and to size what is realistic against FGFS data and Consumer Duty constraints.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Own use-case selection. Build and run the process that turns the productivity-lever map (Risk & Credit, Compliance, Operations, Engineering, Marketing) into a prioritised, deliverable backlog.
  • Translate outcomes into feasible builds. Convert executive asks into scoped, sized work — clear on what is rented (LLMs), bought (platform components) and built (the FGFS layer).
  • Shape the platform with engineering. Co-own the reference architecture with the Senior AI Engineer. Decisions on model gateway, vector store, evaluation harness and monitoring sit jointly.
  • Run the evaluation and quality bar. Define what good looks like for each use case — accuracy, latency, cost, regulatory fit — and hold the line on it.
  • Land use cases into the value streams. Hand over to Product Leads in Open Loop, Customer Servicing, Business Services and Product Development when capability is ready. Stay accountable for outcome.
  • Be the interface to Tymit. Plug into the existing build at Tymit, avoid duplication, agree the joint working pattern.
  • Carry the governance lane. Work with Risk & Compliance so every use case clears the register, evaluation harness and Consumer Duty gate before go-live.

Requirements:

  • Five-plus years in a product role on AI, ML or data products — ideally including LLM-based products shipped to production.
  • Direct experience standing up an AI platform or capability inside an organisation, not just deploying point solutions.
  • Worked in a regulated environment — financial services, healthcare or similar. Comfortable with model risk, evidence trails and consumer-outcome regulation.
  • Track record of choosing build-vs-buy for AI infrastructure (model gateway, vector store, evaluation, observability) and defending the call.
  • Has owned a use-case prioritisation framework end to end — selection, scoring, sequencing, kill decisions.
  • Deep technical literacy: can read a model card, an evaluation report and a system architecture diagram, and challenge them.
  • Strong grasp of retrieval, ontologies, prompt and agent patterns — enough to direct the engineering team, not just listen to them.
  • Commercially literate: sizes business cases, understands unit economics of inference.
  • Writes clearly for executives. Frames trade-offs, not options.
  • Comfortable as an anchor role — operating without a full team around them for the first months.

Nice to have:

  • Consumer credit, lending or payments background.
  • Hands-on engineering background earlier in career.
  • Has worked alongside a partner engineering team (consultancy or sister company) with clear hand-over criteria.

First Six Months — What Good Looks Like

  • Reference architecture v1 signed off and the first platform components live.
  • Use-case selection process running; first two use cases in build, one through governance and into a value stream.
  • Clean working pattern with Tymit — leverage agreed, duplication avoided.
  • Governance lane operating inside existing approvals, not bolted on.
  • Phase 1 core team fully in place and the next phase scoped.

Location: UK - remote with occasional travel to London

Join a young and dynamic consulting firm and continue growing your professional career. Work in international projects with a great work environment.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Director, Crushing Products
description: Director, Crushing Products 5/14/26 Lexington, Kentucky, USA, 40511 35845 Onsite PositionJoin Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!Job Overview Own Product Management Operating System & Portfolio  Accountable for establishing and enforcing the Crushing Product Management Operating Standard across the global portfolio, ensuring clear ownership, lifecycle management, profitability performance, and alignment to strategic growth objectives. Lead Strategy, Roadmap & Lifecycle Management Own development and execution of short and long-term product roadmaps aligned to strategic pillars, including new product development, product enhancements, and lifecycle management to drive growth, installed base expansion, and aftermarket performance. Institutionalize Voice of Customer & Market-Driven Growth Establish and enforce structured VOC processes translating field, dealer, and customer insights into validated roadmap actions, enabling diversification and expansion across mining, cement, aggregates, and industrial minerals. Experience driving disciplined execution through structured processes, governance, and operating rhythms, with accountability for delivering results. High level of emotional intelligence, including effective communication, active listening, and the ability to build trust and align diverse stakeholders. Director, Crushing Products 5/14/26 Lexington, Kentucky, USA, 40511 35845 Onsite Position

Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!

Job Overview

  • Own Product Management Operating System & Portfolio
  • Accountable for establishing and enforcing the Crushing Product Management Operating Standard across the global portfolio, ensuring clear ownership, lifecycle management, profitability performance, and alignment to strategic growth objectives.
  • Lead Strategy, Roadmap & Lifecycle Management
  • Own development and execution of short and long-term product roadmaps aligned to strategic pillars, including new product development, product enhancements, and lifecycle management to drive growth, installed base expansion, and aftermarket performance.
  • Institutionalize Voice of Customer & Market-Driven Growth
  • Establish and enforce structured VOC processes translating field, dealer, and customer insights into validated roadmap actions, enabling diversification and expansion across mining, cement, aggregates, and industrial minerals.
  • Own Product Value, Competitiveness & TCO
  • Own product value, competitiveness, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), including structured competitive analysis to inform differentiation, pricing, and roadmap decisions.
  • Ensure Product Development, Testing & Validation
  • Lead and govern NPD execution, ensuring safety is a foundational design requirement in all products, validated through structured testing and reference site development for performance, reliability, and application fit.
  • Own Commercial Readiness & Go-To-Market Enablement
  • Ensure full commercial readiness across direct and dealer channels, including tools, training, and value messaging, enabling effective product adoption and sales execution.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Execution & Build High-Performance Teams
  • Lead, align, and develop Product Management and Applications teams while driving cross-functional execution across Business Development, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Product Support, and Finance.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Define & Understand the Portfolio
  • Product portfolio management including formal product definition, lifecycle tracking, and gap analysis
  • Own product competitiveness including TCO, margin, and differentiation
  • Ensure alignment between product capability, application requirements, and customer expectations, including validation of performance, specifications, and operating parameters.
  • Drive Market & Commercial Execution
  • Drive ongoing commercial readiness and training enablement across regions and dealers
  • Ensure new product launch readiness and post-launch performance tracking
  • Governance
  • Define and enforce the NPD governance framework as part of the Product Management Operating Standard, including prioritization, stage-gate discipline, and cross-functional alignment to ensure delivery of strategic and financial outcomes.
  • Provide product-level inputs to support forecasting accuracy, including lifecycle transitions, product availability, and demand-shaping factors.

Key Job Responsibities (continued)

  • Build & Validate the Product
  • Own and execute structured product validation plans, including field testing and reference site validation, ensuring product performance, reliability, and application fit are validated through real-world application.
  • Ensure validation results are documented, communicated, and integrated into product decisions, roadmap prioritization, and commercial messaging.
  • Enable Lifecycle Value
  • Ensure products are designed to support aftermarket growth by incorporating serviceability, parts strategy, and lifecycle considerations that enable Product Support to maximize installed base value and profitability.
  • Fund & Measure the System
  • Define and manage capital and development investment requirements, including CapEx for testing infrastructure, NPD funding, and demo/proving equipment, ensuring all investments prioritize safety, compliance, and risk mitigation while supporting validation and commercial success.
  • Ensure VOC pipeline execution and measurable response timelines
  • Lead quarterly Product Health Scorecard reviews across all product lines

Qualifications/Requirements

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in product management, engineering, commercial, or related roles within mining, construction, industrial, or capital equipment environments.
  • Demonstrates progressive experience owning a product line or portfolio, with clear accountability for performance, including revenue growth, margin improvement, and lifecycle management from introduction through phase-out.
  • Makes and owns trade-off decisions that impact product performance, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, and profitability.
  • Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to translate market insights, customer needs, and financial objectives into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.
  • Possesses deep understanding of product application in real operating environments, connecting product design and performance to customer outcomes in the field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and influencing cross-functional teams in a global environment, with a strong track record of collaboration across engineering, commercial, and operational functions.
  • Experience driving disciplined execution through structured processes, governance, and operating rhythms, with accountability for delivering results.
  • High level of emotional intelligence, including effective communication, active listening, and the ability to build trust and align diverse stakeholders.
  • Operates effectively in complex, global, or matrixed environments, navigating competing priorities while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes.
  • Experience from mining, construction, industrial, capital equipment, or similarly complex product environments where lifecycle performance and application fit are critical.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Additional Information

COLLABORATION

Working together with one or more people to complete a project or task or develop ideas or processes.

ADAPTABILITY

Having the ability to adjust to changes in their environment.

HUNTER MENTALITY

A combination of traits that can help someone achieve their goals with consistency and precision.

BUSINESS ACCUMEN

Having the ability to understand business situations and make sound decisions that lead to successful outcomes.

APPLICATION OF KNOWLEDGE

Being able to use what you’ve learned to make decisions and complete tasks in different situations.

LEADERSHIP

The ability to guide, influence or lead others to accomplish a shared goal.

Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

At Komatsu we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions.  We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose.  We are authentic, ambitious, and innovative in our pursuit of Diversity & Inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. 

Company Information

Komatsu is a world leader in manufacturing construction, mining, forestry, and industrial heavy equipment. Founded in 1921, Komatsu has a long history of quality, reliability, innovation, and excellence. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu facilities, distributors and dealers are in more than 140 countries and employ more than 60,000 people. Komatsu offers a diverse and challenging work environment, where you can grow your skills and career, and contribute to a sustainable, clean-energy future. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, be a part of something big and join a team that is shaping the world!

If you want to learn more about Komatsu, please visit our website at https://www.komatsu.com/ .

Accountabilities

  • Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and performance for the Employer of Record platform, ensuring alignment with company objectives and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Lead and scale multiple Product Managers, setting high standards for product discovery, execution, and delivery quality.
  • Translate strategic priorities into clear roadmaps, success metrics, and scalable execution plans across multiple product domains.
  • Drive prioritization across competing initiatives including new features, regulatory requirements, technical debt, and platform improvements.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional product initiatives requiring alignment across Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to ensure the product supports broader business goals, including growth, efficiency, and margin improvement.
  • Use data, insights, and customer feedback to inform decision-making and continuously improve product outcomes.
  • Foster an AI-first, high-performance product culture focused on speed, scalability, and operational excellence.
  • Represent the product domain at executive level, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, risks, and impact.
  • Build and develop a high-performing, remote-first product organization and contribute to broader product best practices.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Product Management, including at least 5+ years in leadership roles managing Product Managers.
  • Strong experience in HR tech, EoR, payroll, compliance, or complex B2B SaaS environments.
  • Proven ability to define and communicate product vision and strategy tied to business and customer outcomes.
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with experience translating complex regulatory or operational requirements into scalable product solutions.
  • Demonstrated success leading multi-team product organizations in high-growth or scale-up environments.
  • Excellent leadership skills with a track record of hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing product talent.
  • Strong product discovery and problem-framing skills, with the ability to turn ambiguity into structured execution plans.
  • Highly data-driven with strong analytical skills and comfort making decisions based on metrics and insights.
  • Experience driving AI-enabled or automation-focused product initiatives is strongly valued.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at executive level.

Benefits

  • Competitive global salary benchmarked to senior product leadership roles
  • Fully remote work with flexible location across Spain and EMEA time zones
  • Generous paid time off (including extended annual leave allowances)
  • Flexible working culture with async-first collaboration practices
  • Comprehensive mental health and wellbeing support programs
  • Home office setup and monthly wellbeing allowance
  • Paid parental leave with strong job protection policies

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

team.blue is an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group; within those brands, 4.000 experts serve its 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses, offering services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce and server hosting solutions and specialist SaaS providers offering adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position Overview

As Head of SaaS AI, you will be responsible for enabling AI Product innovation of our SaaS brands, and aligning their AI initiatives and product roadmaps with the overall team.blue AI & Data strategy.

You will support the brands in creating and executing their AI & Data product roadmaps and initiatives, driving the use of AI & ML in their products and supporting AI & Data product development.

This role will act as the key liaison between the central group AI & Data function and the brands, driving collaboration, and enabling shared AI & Data value creation across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Product Innovation

  • Partner with brands to identify and develop innovative AI products, use cases and initiatives that create business value
  • Design AI solution architectures and flow patterns that align technical possibilities with business stakeholder needs
  • Shape the creation and execution of brand AI product roadmaps and drive AI product innovation to support brand growth priorities and group priorities


Technical Guidance & Support

  • Act as a sounding board for the brand product teams as they build AI products, advising and guiding them and sharing your knowledge of AI & Data advances
  • Support fast development of AI products and initiatives by coordinating access to the group AI & Data teams and resources
  • Aid in the due diligence process of prospective companies when appropriate, by vetting the feasibility and defensibility of their AI & ML-powered products
  • Champion AI upskilling initiatives to increase brand self-sufficiency over time


Strategic Alignment

  • Act as a liaison between the brands and the group AI & Data function, serving as the single point of contact regarding AI & Data topics
  • Coordinate AI initiatives and roadmaps between and across the brands and with the group AI & Data function
  • Ensure alignment of brand AI initiatives with the group AI & Data strategy and priorities while respecting brand autonomy and growth path


Communication & Governance

  • Enable communication flows between the brands and group AI & Data function, ensuring alignment on priorities and supporting rapid decision making
  • Ensure visibility into brand AI & Data activities, timelines, and risks with regular strategic briefings, presentations and updates for executive stakeholders
  • Ensure visibility of group AI & Data resources and initiatives within the brands


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience shipping AI products to real end users and driving AI product innovation, ideally within the SaaS space
  • Strong technical background in AI & Data and understanding of AI and Data's strategic business potential and how to translate it into product features and initiatives
  • Experience shaping and managing product or AI & Data roadmaps in close collaboration with technical, product and commercial teams
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders in a matrixed environment
  • Skilled communicator, able to balance strategic alignment with local autonomy and business priorities
  • Comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels, with the ability to zoom in and out seamlessly, and work across technical and business teams
  • Structured, analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize complex inputs into actionable direction
  • Experience in post-merger integration or multi-brand strategy environments is a plus


"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

ESG

“At team.blue, our commitment to caring for the environment and each other is at the heart of everything we do. Our latest impact report showcases our ongoing ESG efforts and ambitious sustainability goals. Interested in learning more about our dedication to making a positive impact? Check it out here.”

The most trusted digital enabler

team.blue is a leading digital enabler for companies and entrepreneurs. It serves over 3.3 million customers in Europe and has more than 3,000 experts to support them. Its goal is to shape technology and to empower businesses with innovative digital services.

Click here to read more about team.blue

Strategic AI Vision & 3-Year Roadmap

  • Next-Gen Experience Strategy: Own the definition, multi-year sequencing, and execution of the AI experience roadmap across the entire Vivint and NRG smart home portfolio.
  • Predictive Futures: Develop a comprehensive 3-year product roadmap rooted in a deep technical understanding of emerging AI/ML capabilities, translating future technological vectors into immediate, high-value customer benefits.
  • New-to-World Innovation: Autonomously identify, scope, and validate "white space" opportunities to deploy net-new, disruptive AI experiences that shift the smart home from a reactive state to an ambient, proactive state.

Ecosystem Intelligence & Technical Execution

  • Ecosystem Orchestration: Serve as the strategic thought leader on how disparate hardware endpoints (cameras, panels, sensors) and cloud platforms can leverage unified machine learning models to act as a singular, cohesive system.
  • Technical Deep-Dives: Author high-quality, data-driven narrative documents (PRFAQs, Working-Backwards documents, and 3-Year Operating Plans) to align senior executive leadership (VP+) on high-stakes AI investments, algorithm training requirements, and data privacy policies.
  • Data & AI Mechanisms: Define and scale cross-organizational mechanisms to continuously monitor model performance, customer usage telemetry, and behavioral data to rigorously refine and iterate on shipped experiences.

Leadership, Influence & Team Coaching

  • Team Management: Directly manage, mentor, and scale a lean team of high-performing Technical Product Managers, fostering a deep culture of technical excellence, algorithmic rigor, and extreme customer-centricity.
  • Matrixed Influence: Operate independently to influence, unblock, and align a highly cross-functional, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Data Science, AI/ML Platform Engineering, UX Design Language teams, and Hardware Product lines.
  • Execution Excellence: Translate complex machine learning capabilities into precise, unambiguous product requirement documents (PRDs), ensuring a reliable and ethical path from initial model training to mass-market production deployment.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

  • Autonomous AI Strategy: Proven ability to define long-term product frameworks and navigate intense ambiguity independently. You must be comfortable establishing a product path where technical baselines or data sets are completely undefined.
  • AI/ML Product Mastery: Deep technical literacy in applying machine learning approaches to consumer-facing ecosystems. Direct experience productizing capabilities like computer vision, edge-AI processing, natural language processing, or predictive behavioral modeling is required.
  • Ecosystem & Hardware Familiarity: Strong understanding of how software intelligence interacts with physical consumer hardware lifecycles, including ambient wireless frameworks, cloud latency constraints, and local device processing limitations.
  • Stakeholder Influence & Narrative Writing: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Proven track record of presenting complex data science and product concepts clearly to non-technical executive leadership to secure broad organizational alignment.

Required Education & Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated specifically to shipping consumer-facing AI/ML software features, intelligent IoT experiences, or complex data-driven platforms at scale.
  • Technical Partnership Track Record: Demonstrated experience managing products that require close, daily coordination with AI data scientists, machine learning infrastructure engineers, and data privacy teams.
  • Leadership Track Record: 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing technical product professionals, with a proven ability to scale a team's technical capacity.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in a Technical Field (Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline); MBA or equivalent business experience preferred.

The base salary range for this position is: $209,600 - $345,840* *The base salary range above represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonus, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition the position may be eligible to participate in the benefits program which include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending accounts.

To the extent permitted by law and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, employees are subject to periodic random drug testing, and post-accident and reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol testing. EOE AA M/F/Protected Veteran Status/Disability. Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

descriptionHtml:
Sobre Mapit

En Mapit diseñamos tecnología —hardware y software— para la movilidad conectada.

Mediante un ecosistema integrado, potenciamos el vínculo entre marcas como Honda y sus clientes, a través de soluciones que combinan IoT, firmware, analítica avanzada, inteligencia artificial y experiencias digitales.

Ubicación

Barcelona

Modelo híbrido: 3 días en oficina en Barcelona, 2 días en remoto

Full-time

Nuestro reto

Nuestro reto no es solo técnico: es crear un ecosistema digital de servicios que mejore radicalmente la experiencia del usuario final.

Y para eso, buscamos personas senior que quieran tener impacto real en producto y en el equipo que lo crea.

El rol

Mapit está en un momento de crecimiento donde el producto necesita un liderazgo dedicado.

Hoy, muchas decisiones de producto pasan por el CEO — y eso no escala.

Buscamos a alguien que asuma el ownership del producto digital: que defina hacia dónde va, que decida qué se construye y en qué orden, y que lidere al equipo que lo hace realidad.

Liderarás todo el producto digital de Mapit y al equipo de producto/tecnología (8 personas entre devs, producto y data).

Estructurarás el proceso de ideación y validación: asegurar que cada iniciativa llega con evidencia clara, su estimación de coste e impacto, y un estado visible del pipeline de decisiones.

Reportarás directamente al CEO, con autonomía sobre producto.

Tu Responsabilidad Se Reparte En Tres Ejes

Producto

Definir y ejecutar el roadmap, priorizando por impacto real en negocio y usuario.

Ser el punto de referencia para decisiones de producto: qué se construye, qué no, y por qué.

Coordinar producto, negocio y tecnología para que las prioridades estén alineadas y las entregas sean predecibles.

Tecnología y equipo

Liderar al equipo técnico: dar dirección, eliminar bloqueos, asegurar calidad y ritmo de entrega.

Impulsar decisiones basadas en datos y acompañar al CTO en las decisiones de infraestructuras para que soporten el crecimiento.

IA

Implementar y supervisar soluciones de IA aplicadas al producto (trabajando con herramientas como Claude, APIs de modelos, pipelines de datos).

Mejorar el proceso de creación de producto donde la IA suponga una mejora tangible.

Experiencia real trabajando con IA en el día a día y entender cómo cambia los flujos de producción: ciclos más cortos, nuevas formas de iterar, y cómo integrar esto en la forma de trabajar del equipo.

Ser la referencia del equipo en adopción de IA: desde herramientas de desarrollo (Claude Code) hasta casos de uso en el producto.

El perfil que buscamos

+8 años de experiencia liderando producto digital end-to-end (apps, SaaS, plataformas) con equipos a tu cargo.

Capacidad real de combinar visión de producto con profundidad técnica — el CTO lidera las decisiones de arquitectura, pero tú entiendes el contexto, hablas con devs en su idioma y participas con criterio.

Experiencia implementando o supervisando IA aplicada a producto — no teórica, sino práctica: has trabajado con APIs de modelos, has integrado IA en flujos reales, sabes distinguir lo que aporta valor de lo que es hype.

Fuerte criterio de priorización: sabes decir "no" y defender por qué.

Capacidad para trabajar con un CEO involucrado en la experiencia de producto, construyendo una relación de confianza donde ganes autonomía progresivamente con resultados.

Español e inglés avanzado (C1).

Muy valorable

Experiencia en IoT, plataformas conectadas o entornos donde convienen hardware y software.

Experiencia en modelos B2B2C (marcas + usuarios finales).

Haber trabajado en empresas en fase de crecimiento o scale-up, donde la estructura se construye mientras se ejecuta.

Este rol es para ti si...

Te motiva construir, no solo planificar — prefieres un entorno donde tu trabajo tiene impacto directo cada semana.

Te gusta liderar desde la trinchera: estás igual de cómodo/a en una sesión de roadmap que resolviendo un bloqueo técnico con el equipo.

Necesitas poca estructura para avanzar — te organizas bien en entornos con ambigüedad y sabes crear orden donde no lo hay.

La IA no es un tema de conversación para ti, es una herramienta que ya usas a diario para trabajar mejor.

Lo que ofrecemos

Producto propio con impacto real, en un equipo que trabaja en la frontera de IoT e inteligencia artificial.

Contrato indefinido y salario competitivo, acorde a tu experiencia y responsabilidad.

Modelo híbrido: 3 días en oficina en Barcelona, 2 días en remoto.

Horario flexible con viernes tarde libre.

Seguro médico Adeslas gratuito.

23 días de vacaciones + 10 días adicionales de teletrabajo al año.

Dispositivos y Suscripciones Mapit gratuitos.

Sabemos que nadie encaja al 100 % en una descripción.

Si tienes experiencia liderando producto y tecnología, criterio técnico y ganas de construir algo con impacto, aplica, aunque no marques todas las casillas.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As Head of Physical Products & IoT you'll lead our entire physical product stack: towers, turnstiles, mobile nodes, fleet management systems, and back-end support applications. This means P&L ownership, building product life cycle processes from scratch, and coaching a team of 7+ Product Owners and Product Specialists to think more commercially, help them prioritize, and move faster.

You'll work closely alongside the Head of Digital Products & Customer Experience, who leads customer-facing software solutions. Together you'll ensure our physical and digital products work seamlessly to deliver on our site intelligence vision. This isn't a maintenance role. We're scaling hard and need someone who can handle the chaos, help to build the right structure without slowing us down, and make the team better.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement & manage the product P&Ls. Business cases, revenue targets, product margins in collaboration with the Group Pricing Manager - the full commercial picture.
  • Build product lifecycle management processes that actually work at scale. Discovery, development, launch, optimization, end-of-life.
  • Coach a team of Product Owners & specialists. Make them better at commercial thinking, prioritization, and shipping. Develop future leaders (currently 8 individuals).
  • Set product strategy for hardware, embedded systems, and internal software that keeps our fleet running. Balance innovation with what customers need & sustaining engineering.
  • Partner with the Head of Digital Products & Customer Experience to ensure physical and digital products integrate seamlessly and deliver the full customer experience.
  • Drive new (physical) product launches across 11 countries. Work with Product Marketing, Sales, Ops, and Engineering to get products to market and make them successful.
  • Push the team on modern practices. AI tools, improve & implement processes, creative problem-solving. Question how we do things and make it better.


Job Requirements

 What we’re looking for

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in product, with 5+ years leading teams. Hardware, IoT, or embedded systems experience required.
  • You've run Product P&Ls before. You know how to make money, not just ship features.
  • High-growth experience. You've been through 30%+ annual growth, you know how to scale despite things breaking all the time
  • You're a coach, not a micromanager. You make people better and they want to work with you. You go deep, when needed, to ensure output quality
  • You understand hardware reality - supply chains, manufacturing constraints, field deployment. You can talk to engineers and translate it to business value.
  • You work well with peer leaders. You'll partner closely with the Head of Digital Products to create cohesive experiences across hardware and software.
  • Positive energy. You get excited about hard problems. Teams follow you and go the extra mile because they want to, not because they have to.
  • Fluent in English (C1/C2-level), additional languages are a plus. You'll be working across countries and need to communicate clearly.


What matters:

  • Bias for action over perfect plans
  • Commercial instinct - knowing what will actually make money
  • Building for scale, not just today
  • Making your team better, not just getting your own work done
  • Comfort with ambiguity and changing fast when needed
  • Willing to work - it’s a full-time role


What you can expect from us

  • Real impact. Construction sites are dangerous. We're building the intelligence to prevent incidents before they happen - both security and safety.
  • You'll shape how we scale. Not many people get to build product processes for a company growing this fast.
  • Leadership opportunity with full ownership. Product P&Ls, team, strategy.
  • Smart, driven people who care about getting things done.
  • Fast-paced environment where every day is different.


Logistics:

  • One-year contract, then extension with indefinite
  • Competitive salary + bonus
  • 25 vacation days (option to buy more)
  • Everything you need to be successful incl. Laptop, mobile, car, pension plan


Who we are

BauWatch is Europe's #1 in temporary security solutions, growing 30% YoY. We're in 11 countries, 44,000+ projects completed, and we're moving fast.

Our vision: “Zero incidence, faster delivery - through connected site intelligence that protects by design.”

We combine ruggedized monitoring towers, sensors, access control solutions, intelligent edge devices, fleet management, and 24/7 remote monitoring into a connected system. Construction and temporary sites are among the most dangerous work environments - we're building the intelligence to catch security and safety threats before they become incidents.

Interested?

If so please Apply with a cv and a salary expectation.

For questions or more information contact Ruud Licht, Group Recruitment Officer at +31 6 20172020.

title: Director of Product, Growth/AI
description: Why join usBrex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.Product at BrexThe Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We are responsible for aligning cross-functional teams — such as Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design — on key decisions. We set strategy and drive products from inception to launch, enabling Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.What You’ll DoAs a Product Leader at Brex, you will be the driving force behind our Growth Product team — overseeing the thoughtful strategy and execution of team and technical systems to drive customer acquisition and onboarding. You will also collaborate closely with our Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure seamless acquisition and onboarding for customers, particularly those with significant and complex spending needs. You will be instrumental in creating features, models, and tools that empower our GTM and Marketing teams to get maximal leverage out of their efforts. You will work closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, based in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Vancouver, Brazil, and remote locations. Past examples of work in this domain include AI agents for GTM workflows, developing best-in-class GTM data and enrichment systems, ML models for account prioritization, prospect AI classification systems, and more.Where you’ll workThis role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least 3 days per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.ResponsibilitiesDrive product and systems investments that improve GTM metrics such as CAC payback, pipeline conversion, and efficiency.Define and execute a multi-quarter Growth strategy in partnership with Engineering, Design, GTM, Marketing, Ops, and Data to deliver high-impact, scalable products with measurable business impact.Embed within Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify workflow bottlenecks and lead automation and optimization initiatives.Analyze GTM funnel and conversion metrics to uncover insights and guide product priorities and roadmap decisions.Set clear goals, metrics, and success criteria for the Growth team, driving accountability to measurable outcomes.Manage and develop a team of Product Managers, fostering clarity, ownership, and a culture of high performance.Oversee core Growth Product and Engineering domains, including account scoring, TAM data, outbound automation, and GTM tooling.Align stakeholders around an aspirational 6–12 month roadmap that advances GTM efficiency and business growth.Ensure successful activation and implementation of customers initiatives by partnering with GTM and Customer Success to operationalize tooling and automations.Continuously refine activation based on feedback and performance data to drive faster time-to-value and sustainable adoption.RequirementsRelevant experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or management consulting, ideally with direct responsibility for or experience scaling B2B products and GTM systems, with a strong understanding of growth, GTM, and/or marketing pipelines.Analytical sense: You demonstrate a strong aptitude for and actively use data to inform your decision-making. Basic SQL proficiency is strongly preferred.Communication: You have proven experience working and communicating effectively with senior leaders and executives, and influencing stakeholders across departments and functions, including Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, CRMX/Business Systems, IT, Legal, and more. You excel at building trust and working relationships.Systems-thinker: You are a systems thinker, capable of thinking holistically across product, technical, and people systems to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for efficiency, automation, fraud prevention, and product growth within the payables ecosystem.CompensationThe expected salary range for this role is $340,000 - $425,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Past examples of work in this domain include AI agents for GTM workflows, developing best-in-class GTM data and enrichment systems, ML models for account prioritization, prospect AI classification systems, and more.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least 3 days per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.

Responsibilities

  • Drive product and systems investments that improve GTM metrics such as CAC payback, pipeline conversion, and efficiency.
  • Define and execute a multi-quarter Growth strategy in partnership with Engineering, Design, GTM, Marketing, Ops, and Data to deliver high-impact, scalable products with measurable business impact.
  • Embed within Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify workflow bottlenecks and lead automation and optimization initiatives.
  • Analyze GTM funnel and conversion metrics to uncover insights and guide product priorities and roadmap decisions.
  • Set clear goals, metrics, and success criteria for the Growth team, driving accountability to measurable outcomes.
  • Manage and develop a team of Product Managers, fostering clarity, ownership, and a culture of high performance.
  • Oversee core Growth Product and Engineering domains, including account scoring, TAM data, outbound automation, and GTM tooling.
  • Align stakeholders around an aspirational 6–12 month roadmap that advances GTM efficiency and business growth.
  • Ensure successful activation and implementation of customers initiatives by partnering with GTM and Customer Success to operationalize tooling and automations.
  • Continuously refine activation based on feedback and performance data to drive faster time-to-value and sustainable adoption.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or management consulting, ideally with direct responsibility for or experience scaling B2B products and GTM systems, with a strong understanding of growth, GTM, and/or marketing pipelines.
  • Analytical sense: You demonstrate a strong aptitude for and actively use data to inform your decision-making. Basic SQL proficiency is strongly preferred.
  • Communication: You have proven experience working and communicating effectively with senior leaders and executives, and influencing stakeholders across departments and functions, including Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, CRMX/Business Systems, IT, Legal, and more. You excel at building trust and working relationships.
  • Systems-thinker: You are a systems thinker, capable of thinking holistically across product, technical, and people systems to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for efficiency, automation, fraud prevention, and product growth within the payables ecosystem.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $340,000 - $425,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.
