descriptionHtml:
Head of Product, Americas – New York City, NY

PineBridge Investments, A MetLife Investment Management Company.

MetLife Investment Management (MIM) has successfully acquired PineBridge as of December 30, 2025. MetLife Investment Management and PineBridge Investments now have more to offer; broader reach, deeper insights and specialized capabilities – forming a top-tier global investment platform.

Together, we have more than $700 billion in assets under management as of September 30, 2025 and aim to deliver consistent risk-adjusted returns. From multi-asset, equities, and fixed income to private credit and real estate, we offer specialized capabilities backed by a broader global reach and regionally grounded insights tailored to investor needs.

What sets us apart isn’t just the breadth of our platform and capabilities — it’s how we partner. Across both firms, we share a strong investment culture that prioritizes partnership, transparency and accountability. We believe that our clients benefit from direct access to decision-makers and reinforced by a culture that views decisions through the client’s perspective. Join us and experience the excitement of working with the brightest minds in the industry, shaping the future of asset management.

The role will be based in New York City with the expectation of a hybrid work model.

The Americas Head of Product will own and drive MIM’s product strategy, development and management efforts in the region. The role requires a deep understanding of public and private markets and how to enable access to these capabilities across investor channels. The successful candidate will play a critical role in assessing, prioritizing and delivering a pipeline of products in line with MIM’s strategic ambitions, and will be responsible for the Americas product suite throughout the product lifecycle. It is necessary to have the gravitas and confidence to operate at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership, and the judgement to provide constructive challenge and help shape effective decision making.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Product function in the Americas across product strategy, development, and management for public and private markets. You will be the go-to person for all product-related matters in the region
  • Stay on top of trends and opportunities with support from the Product Intelligence team; deliver proactive insights to inform decision making on the go-forward Product strategy
  • In partnership with the Global Head of Product and broader team, develop a focused product pipeline for the region that prioritizes client needs, aligns with MIM’s broader strategy, and facilitates efficient scale and profitability
  • Lead the end-to-end process of product design, launch, enhancements and closures in the Americas
  • Oversight of the Americas Product line up to support the delivery of strategic objectives and financial targets
  • Present information and recommendations to a variety of internal and external stakeholders in a clear, confident manner, including Board and Committee Members and Senior Leadership
  • Build strong and robust relationships with colleagues across functions to ensure effective product delivery including Client Group, Investments, Legal, Operations, and Senior Management
  • Act as a trusted advisor to colleagues; instill confidence in your ability and constructively challenge thinking where needed
  • Uphold a strong risk management and compliance culture within the Product function, operating within regulatory and statutory requirements and ensure that MIM meets its fiduciary responsibilities

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience (10+ years) across product strategy, development and management (full product lifecycle)
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from an accredited college or university
  • Track record of successful strategic planning, direction, and execution on high-priority matters
  • Strong investment knowledge across public and private markets strategies
  • Experience in establishing and maintaining comingled funds, funds of one, and SMAs for the Americas across investor channels
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and nurture strategic relationships with team members across functions and levels of seniority to lead and influence the determination and execution of initiatives
  • Familiarity with harnessing data from key databases to help inform decision making and prioritization, such as eVestment, Preqin, Broadridge, etc.
  • Ability to understand complex product and structuring issues to ensure proper direction and efficient resolution
  • Decisive and able to work independently to drive initiatives forward
  • Ability to multi-task and manage conflicting priorities while staying organized to achieve success for the firm

About PineBridge

PineBridge is proud of our award-winning culture, which reflects our commitment to empowering employees and fostering a collaborative work environment. For six consecutive years (2020-2025), PineBridge has been named a ‘Best Place to Work in Money Management’ by Pensions & Investments, a leading industry designation which recognizes the best employers in the asset management industry by evaluating employer benefits, policies, and responses to an employee survey. In 2023, PineBridge received Hong Kong Institute for HR Management Elite awards for ‘Best Workplace’ and ‘Learning & Development’ and in 2024 we received Merit awards for ‘Talent Acquisition’ and ‘Employee Benefits.’ Alongside this, in 2023 and 2024 PineBridge was recognized as a finalist at the 100 Women in Finance’s APAC Industry Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Award.

Our benefits: We offer a wide range of family friendly benefits including comprehensive healthcare, back-up childcare program to support working parents and flexible work arrangements so you can be there for the people you care about. We also provide a competitive retirement plan and tuition reimbursement. Furthermore, we have a robust list of professional development opportunities with the goal of engaging, retaining, and developing our talent.

Our values: We value our clients, investment excellence, collaboration with our distributed team members, empowerment, and independence as we honor our heritage and our roots.

  • Salary Range: $250,000-280,000 annually + bonus + benefits
  • The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we’ll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Overview:

The Applied Machine Learning Group creates personalized streaming experiences that go beyond recommendations, shaping how audiences discover, engage with, and experience content across Paramount+ and Pluto TV. Through deep audience intelligence, multimodal content understanding, and advanced machine learning, we power real-time discovery, personalized engagement, and next-generation short-form and interactive viewing experiences. Our work directly connects millions of viewers to

the stories they love while driving meaningful business impact for Paramount Streaming.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Director of Technical Product Management to lead product strategy, execution, and organizational direction for the machine learning platform and infrastructure that powers personalization, content intelligence, and AI-driven streaming experiences across Paramount’s global ecosystem.

This leader will own the vision, roadmap, and measurable impact of foundational ML capabilities, spanning:

  • Model training, evaluation, and lifecycle management
  • Real-time and batch model serving infrastructure
  • Feature stores, data pipelines, and ML data platforms
  • Runtime systems, integrations, and developer toolin
  • Reliability, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency of AI systems

You will partner closely with engineering, data science, product, and executive leadership to ensure our ML platform enables rapid innovation, production-grade reliability, and efficient global scale.

This is a highly strategic and deeply technical leadership role responsible not only for how ML systems are built and operated, but for how platform capabilities accelerate the future of AI across Paramount Streaming.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Vision

  • Define and lead the multi-year ML platform and infrastructure strategy supporting personalization, discovery, and content intelligence
  • Translate company-level goals into scalable platform investments with clear reliability, performance, and cost outcomes
  • Identify and incubate next-generation ML platform capabilities, including real-time inference, foundation model enablement, and multimodal infrastructure
  • Represent ML platform strategy at the executive and cross-company level

Technical Product Leadership

  • End-to-end ML lifecycle platforms (training → deployment → monitoring → iteration)
  • Real-time and batch inference infrastructure
  • Feature stores, data pipelines, and offline/online consistency
  • Experimentation enablement and safe model rollout
  • Developer productivity, tooling, and platform APIs
  • Partner with ML, platform, and cloud engineering to ensure scalable, reliable, secure, and cost-efficient AI systems
  • Drive alignment between research innovation, platform capabilities, and production readiness

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of technical product managers
  • Establish operating rhythms, product standards, and roadmap governance across personalization
  • Foster a data-driven, experimentation-first culture across cross-functional teams
  • Influence roadmaps across UX, growth, marketing, and content strategy

Measurement & Business Impact

  • Define north-star metrics for ML platform success, including:
    • Model deployment velocity
    • System reliability and latency
    • Infrastructure cost efficiency
    • Developer productivity
  • Ensure rigorous observability, experimentation safety, and operational excellence
  • Balance long-term platform investment with near-term product acceleration
  • Communicate platform impact clearly to executive stakeholders and business leadership

Industry Leadership

  • Stay at the forefront of:
    • Large-scale ML platforms and MLOps evolution
    • Real-time inference and distributed model serving
    • Foundation model infrastructure and multimodal systems
    • Cloud-native and hybrid AI architectures
  • Bring external perspective and best practices from leading consumer technology and AI-driven platforms.

Required Expertise

ML Platforms & Infrastructure

  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle systems, including training, deployment, monitoring, and iteration
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Real-time vs batch inference architectures
    • Feature stores and data consistency
    • Distributed systems, scalability, and reliability
    • Cost optimization in large-scale AI environments
AI/ML Engineering Ecosystem

  • Experience with:
    • MLOps platforms, orchestration, and CI/CD for ML
    • Data pipelines, streaming systems, and offline/online parity
    • Model observability, drift detection, and safe rollout strategies
    • Cloud infrastructure and performance optimization
Data, Experimentation & Analytics

  • Understanding of experimentation frameworks and model evaluation in production environments
  • Fluency in SQL, Python, and data analysis workflows
  • Ability to translate system performance and telemetry into product direction

Product & Business Leadership

  • Proven track record defining platform strategy with measurable engineering and business impact
  • Experience prioritizing investments across reliability, scalability, developer velocity, and cost
  • Strong executive communication and strategic storytelling

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Experience leading PMs or complex platform product areas
  • Ability to align engineering, science, infrastructure, and business stakeholders
  • Strong influence across matrixed global organizations

Technical Prototyping & Tools

  • Demonstrated proficiency with coding tools (e.g., Python, SQL, IDEs) and platforms (e.g., GitHub) necessary for conducting technical analysis and proof-of-concept development.
  • Familiarity with leveraging AI coding assistants and modern development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini for developers) to accelerate rapid prototyping and technical investigation.
  • Ability to independently create and demonstrate basic Proofs of Concept (POCs) for recommendation and personalization features.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in product management, including
    • 5+ years leading ML platform, infrastructure, or AI-driven systems
    • People leadership of PMs or equivalent scope
  • Demonstrated success delivering large-scale ML platforms or distributed AI infrastructure in:
    • Streaming, consumer technology, cloud platforms, or AI-first companies
  • Deep technical fluency across ML systems, data infrastructure, and distributed architectures
  • Hands-on technical fluency to the point of being able to develop basic Proofs of Concept (POCs) and prototypes for new product ideas, utilizing modern coding tools and AI development assistants.
  • Strong business intuition tied to velocity, reliability, and cost efficiency at scale
  • Passion for building the technical foundations that power the future of streaming AI

Why Join Us

  • Architect the ML platform powering personalization for millions of global viewers
  • Enable the next generation of AI-driven streaming experiences across Paramount+ and Pluto TV
  • Work alongside world-class ML engineers, platform architects, and researchers
  • Influence company-level AI infrastructure strategy and long-term platform evolution
  • Build and scale a high-impact technical product organization at the core of AMLG

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

Additional Information

Hiring Salary Range: $213,360.00 - 320,040.00.

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable, as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement. This position is bonus eligible.

What We Offer:

  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

Paramount is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) including disability/vet.

At Paramount, the spirit of inclusion feeds into everything that we do, on-screen and off. From the programming and movies we create to employee benefits/programs and social impact outreach initiatives, we believe that opportunity, access, resources and rewards should be available to and for the benefit of all. Paramount is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, and Veteran status.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access https://www.paramount.com/careers as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by calling 212.846.5500 or by sending an email to paramountaccommodations@paramount.com. Only messages left for this purpose will be returned.

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We are responsible for aligning cross-functional teams — such as Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design — on key decisions. We set strategy and drive products from inception to launch, enabling Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Leader at Brex, you will be the driving force behind our Growth Product team — overseeing the thoughtful strategy and execution of team and technical systems to drive customer acquisition and onboarding. You will also collaborate closely with our Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure seamless acquisition and onboarding for customers, particularly those with significant and complex spending needs. You will be instrumental in creating features, models, and tools that empower our GTM and Marketing teams to get maximal leverage out of their efforts. You will work closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, based in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Vancouver, Brazil, and remote locations. Past examples of work in this domain include AI agents for GTM workflows, developing best-in-class GTM data and enrichment systems, ML models for account prioritization, prospect AI classification systems, and more.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least 3 days per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.

Responsibilities

  • Drive product and systems investments that improve GTM metrics such as CAC payback, pipeline conversion, and efficiency.
  • Define and execute a multi-quarter Growth strategy in partnership with Engineering, Design, GTM, Marketing, Ops, and Data to deliver high-impact, scalable products with measurable business impact.
  • Embed within Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify workflow bottlenecks and lead automation and optimization initiatives.
  • Analyze GTM funnel and conversion metrics to uncover insights and guide product priorities and roadmap decisions.
  • Set clear goals, metrics, and success criteria for the Growth team, driving accountability to measurable outcomes.
  • Manage and develop a team of Product Managers, fostering clarity, ownership, and a culture of high performance.
  • Oversee core Growth Product and Engineering domains, including account scoring, TAM data, outbound automation, and GTM tooling.
  • Align stakeholders around an aspirational 6–12 month roadmap that advances GTM efficiency and business growth.
  • Ensure successful activation and implementation of customers initiatives by partnering with GTM and Customer Success to operationalize tooling and automations.
  • Continuously refine activation based on feedback and performance data to drive faster time-to-value and sustainable adoption.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or management consulting, ideally with direct responsibility for or experience scaling B2B products and GTM systems, with a strong understanding of growth, GTM, and/or marketing pipelines.
  • Analytical sense: You demonstrate a strong aptitude for and actively use data to inform your decision-making. Basic SQL proficiency is strongly preferred.
  • Communication: You have proven experience working and communicating effectively with senior leaders and executives, and influencing stakeholders across departments and functions, including Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, CRMX/Business Systems, IT, Legal, and more. You excel at building trust and working relationships.
  • Systems-thinker: You are a systems thinker, capable of thinking holistically across product, technical, and people systems to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for efficiency, automation, fraud prevention, and product growth within the payables ecosystem.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $340,000 - $425,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

The Senior Director partners cross‑functionally with Marketing, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Executive Leadership to deliver a robust innovation pipeline that fuels company growth.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Own the multi‑year innovation strategy and product roadmap in alignment with brand, business, and revenue goals.
  • Lead and mentor teams across Formulation Science, Product Development, and Regulatory Affairs, ensuring strong collaboration and high performance.
  • Translate consumer insights, scientific trends, and market opportunities into actionable product concepts.
  • Build and manage the NPD budget, resource planning, and external partnerships (CMOs, labs, testing partners, ingredient suppliers).

Product Development & Innovation

  • Oversee the full product lifecycle from ideation through launch, including concept development, feasibility, prototyping, testing, and scale‑up.
  • Ensure all projects meet performance targets, cost of goods (COGs), timelines, and brand standards.
  • Drive technical problem‑solving, risk assessment, and contingency planning throughout development.
  • Champion scientific rigor and data‑driven decision‑making in evaluating new technologies, ingredients, and claims.

Formulation & R&D Oversight

  • Guide formulation strategy across categories (e.g., haircare, skincare, body, OTC, or other relevant segments).
  • Ensure formulation teams deliver stable, safe, high‑performing prototypes that meet regulatory and brand requirements.
  • Oversee analytical testing, stability studies, compatibility testing, and scale‑up readiness.
  • Maintain strong relationships with external labs and manufacturing partners to accelerate innovation.

Regulatory Affairs Leadership

  • Oversee regulatory strategy for all new products, ensuring compliance with global regulations (e.g., FDA, EU, Health Canada, ASEAN, etc.).
  • Ensure accurate and timely creation of documentation including INCI lists, SDS, claims substantiation, safety assessments, and product registrations.
  • Partner with Legal and Quality to evaluate claims, labeling, and marketing materials.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and proactively adjust development strategies.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary liaison between R&D, Marketing, Operations, and Supply Chain to ensure seamless product launches.
  • Partner with Marketing to translate concepts into technically feasible products with compelling claims.
  • Work with Operations and Supply Chain to ensure manufacturability, cost targets, and supplier readiness.
  • Collaborate with Quality to ensure compliance with GMP and internal quality standards.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, mentor, and develop a high‑performing, multidisciplinary NPD organization.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, scientific excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish clear KPIs, development plans, and performance metrics for all direct reports.

Qualifications

  • Masters’ degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Cosmetic Science, Biology, or related field; PhD preferred.
  • 15–20+ years of experience in product development, formulation, or R&D within beauty, personal care, or related consumer goods.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing multi‑disciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of global cosmetic and/or OTC regulatory frameworks.
  • Proven track record of bringing innovative products from concept to market.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and cross‑functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment.
  • Future-Fit Skills:Customer Experience, Creativity, Problem Solving
  • Leadership Behaviours: Stay Three Steps Ahead, Care Deeply, Deliver with Excellence, Focus on What Count

As an equal opportunities’ employer, Unilever Prestige Hub Brands/Tatcha/Murad//Living Proof/K18 is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership.

We aspire to have a diverse workforce because, in our view, diversity enables better business outcomes. We also believe that a more inclusive workplace, where people of different backgrounds work together, ensures better outcomes for all staff. From application to interview, we place inclusion at the heart of all we do. In particular, we strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join Unilever Prestige Hub Brands/Tatcha/Murad//Living Proof/K18.

descriptionHtml:
EMPORIA HOLDINGS, Director of Product


Remote | Preferred locations: St. Louis, MO · Kansas City, MO · Chicago, IL


About the Opportunity

Emporia Holdings builds the software that runs the modern resale economy. Our platforms power more than $2 billion in annual sales across 4,000+ store locations spanning thrift, consignment, wholesale, and online channels for secondhand and preloved goods. From neighborhood consignment boutiques to multi-location vendor malls, we are the operating system behind a fast-growing, sustainability-driven category that mainstream retail software was never built to serve.


We deeply embrace AI and emerging technology — not as a buzzword, but as a core lever for how we build product, serve operators, and reimagine what resale software can do. As Director of Product Management, you will sit at the center of that ambition, leading product strategy and execution across a portfolio of platforms and the teams that bring them to life.

Emporia is part of the K1 Investment Management family, one of the leading software-focused investment firms in the world. That means the resources, discipline, and growth trajectory of a backed enterprise — paired with the pace, ownership, and impact of a company that is still writing its next chapter.


What Makes This Role Different

  • Real scale, real impact. Your decisions shape software that touches billions in transactions and thousands of independent businesses every single day.
  • A portfolio, not a product. This role spans multiple companies and product lines, demanding strong program and project management and the ability to drive several initiatives forward at once.
  • AI at the core. You will help define how intelligent, AI-powered capabilities become a defining differentiator across our platforms.
  • A category with momentum. Resale and secondhand commerce is one of retail's fastest-growing segments — and we are building the infrastructure underneath it.


What You'll Do

  • Own product strategy across the portfolio — setting vision and roadmaps that span multiple companies and platforms, balancing near-term delivery with a coherent long-term direction.
  • Lead the full product lifecycle — from ideation, research, and design through development, launch, and iteration in an Agile environment.
  • Manage multiple initiatives in parallel — apply rigorous program and project management to keep concurrent workstreams on schedule, on scope, and aligned.
  • Turn data into decisions — use analytics and customer insight to identify trends, prioritize ruthlessly, and measure impact on customer satisfaction and business outcomes.
  • Champion AI-driven innovation — partner with engineering and leadership to embed AI capabilities that meaningfully advance the product and the category.
  • Collaborate across functions — work hand-in-hand with engineers, designers, customer success, sales, and marketing to ensure features map to real customer needs and business goals.
  • Communicate with stakeholders — regularly report progress, manage expectations, and own the delivery and quality of what ships.
  • Know the market deeply — understand the resale landscape, competition, and operators well enough to spot the opportunities others miss.


What You Bring

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Senior PM, or Director of Product in a software or SaaS environment.
  • A strong track record managing multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated fluency with Agile methodologies and modern product development practices.
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to decision making.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging technology — and a point of view on how to apply it.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills — the ability to influence, align, and build strong relationships across teams.
  • A high level of accountability, ownership, and entrepreneurial spirit.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, resale, consignment, or marketplace software — highly desired but not required. We will teach the category to the right person.
  • Experience in a private-equity-backed or portfolio-company environment.
  • Familiarity with wireframing and UX design principles.
  • Technical understanding of software development and web technologies.


Who You Are

  • You are curious and eager to learn, able to rapidly absorb new technology and market trends.
  • You are self-motivated, energized by complex problems, and comfortable moving fast across multiple projects at once.
  • You hold yourself accountable, you bring others with you, and you are a genuine team player committed to the success of the people around you and the business as a whole.


Why Emporia

  • Meaningful scale — your work powers billions in commerce and thousands of small businesses.
  • Backed for growth — the stability and resources of the K1 Investment Management family.
  • A category on the rise — resale and sustainability are reshaping how the world shops.
  • Comprehensive benefits — health and wellness benefits, retirement plans, and real growth opportunities.
  • Ownership and impact — a seat at the center of strategy, with the autonomy to shape outcomes.


Ready to build the future of resale? If you are passionate about product, thrive in a fast-paced and AI-forward environment, and want to make a real impact at scale — we want to hear from you. Apply today.

descriptionHtml:
About SimpliSafe

We're a high-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. We've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no-ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those we protect. We don't just want you to work here — we want you to grow and thrive here.

We are embracing a hybrid work model: our teams come together in our state-of-the-art office on two out of our three core days (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) and choose where they work for the remainder of the week.

Why Are We Hiring?

We're growing and thriving — so we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

What sets SimpliSafe apart in the AI space: many companies focus on SaaS and machine learning. We do that as well — but we also deploy AI directly on cameras, which is a significantly more complex technical challenge. We're looking for a leader who has done this before and is excited to push the frontier of on-device intelligence at scale.

What You'll Do

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this Head of AI will lead SimpliSafe's entire Artificial Intelligence organization — spanning AI/ML/CV infrastructure and research, and AI-powered product experiences across SimpliSafe's consumer portfolio.

We are looking for a visionary leader who can drive innovation across both the technical platform and the product surface: building the foundational AI capabilities that power our hardware and cloud, while also partnering closely with Product to define and ship the AI-driven features our customers experience every day. This position requires strategic thinking, deep technical expertise — including on-device and edge AI — and the ability to lead and grow a high-performing, multi-disciplinary organization.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Partner with the executive team to develop and execute the company-wide AI strategy — spanning platform, infrastructure, product, and research — aligned to SimpliSafe's mission and business objectives.
  • Own the AI product roadmap in close partnership with Product Management, defining the AI-powered experiences customers see and interact with across our apps, devices, and monitoring services.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams — Product, Engineering, Design, and Operations — to identify and prioritize opportunities to leverage AI/ML/CV technology to drive customer value and business growth.
  • Drive the platform and infrastructural requirements for enablement of consumer-facing and internal AI/ML/CV capabilities — both in the cloud and on-device, including on constrained hardware such as cameras and embedded systems.
  • Manage the AI organization's budget, allocate resources effectively across platform and product workstreams, and make data-driven decisions to optimize cost-efficiency.
  • Set technical standards and best practices across SimpliSafe in the use of AI/ML/CV technologies, with particular emphasis on model optimization for edge and on-device deployment.
  • Stay current with the latest research and advancements in computer vision, on-device AI, generative AI, and embedded ML — and translate emerging capabilities into product opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with external partners, vendors, and research organizations.
  • Design and evolve the organizational structure of the AI team to support both current needs and future scale — including hiring, developing, and retaining world-class talent across research, engineering, and applied AI.
  • Lead, manage, and mentor a talented, multi-disciplinary team of AI/ML/CV engineers and applied scientists, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
  • Inspire your team to achieve our Every Home Secure mission.

What You'll Bring

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience: 15+ years of experience in AI/ML, computer vision, or a related field, with a track record of shipping AI-powered products to consumers.
  • AI for Product: Demonstrated experience owning AI product strategy and roadmap — not just the platform — including close collaboration with Product Management to define, prioritize, and ship AI-driven customer features.
  • Edge & On-Device AI: Deep, hands-on experience building and productizing AI solutions that run on constrained and edge devices (e.g., cameras, embedded systems, IoT hardware) — not just cloud or SaaS deployments.
  • Computer Vision Depth: Strong knowledge of computer vision techniques including object detection, segmentation, tracking, and recognition. Deep experience developing and productizing cutting-edge CV techniques.
  • Hardware Fluency: Deep knowledge of sensors, camera technologies, and the hardware/software co-design considerations unique to on-device inference.
  • Strategic Leadership: Demonstrated ability to develop and execute long-range AI strategy, including articulating how AI will evolve over the next several years and how an organization should adapt and position itself.
  • People Management: Demonstrated ability to inspire and develop teams quickly, attract and retain talent, design organizations for scale, and implement and sustain impactful business change processes.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Respect: Respect and understanding of other disciplines, including Industrial Design, User Experience, Product Development, Quality, and Manufacturing.
  • Global Experience: Demonstrated experience working with global teams and with products manufactured outside the United States.
  • Mindset: A 'no job too small' entrepreneurial attitude and a passion for the consumer and the Every Home Secure mission.

What Values You'll Share

  • Customer Obsessed — Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
  • Aim High — Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
  • No Ego — Maintaining a 'no job too small' attitude, and an open, inclusive, and humble style.
  • One Team — Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
  • Lift As We Climb — Investing in developing others and helping those around us succeed.
  • Lean & Nimble — Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often-ambiguous environment.

Equal Opportunity

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute — not only to our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for all. descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

team.blue is an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group; within those brands, 4.000 experts serve its 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses, offering services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce and server hosting solutions and specialist SaaS providers offering adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position Overview

As Head of SaaS AI, you will be responsible for enabling AI Product innovation of our SaaS brands, and aligning their AI initiatives and product roadmaps with the overall team.blue AI & Data strategy.

You will support the brands in creating and executing their AI & Data product roadmaps and initiatives, driving the use of AI & ML in their products and supporting AI & Data product development.

This role will act as the key liaison between the central group AI & Data function and the brands, driving collaboration, and enabling shared AI & Data value creation across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Product Innovation

  • Partner with brands to identify and develop innovative AI products, use cases and initiatives that create business value
  • Design AI solution architectures and flow patterns that align technical possibilities with business stakeholder needs
  • Shape the creation and execution of brand AI product roadmaps and drive AI product innovation to support brand growth priorities and group priorities


Technical Guidance & Support

  • Act as a sounding board for the brand product teams as they build AI products, advising and guiding them and sharing your knowledge of AI & Data advances
  • Support fast development of AI products and initiatives by coordinating access to the group AI & Data teams and resources
  • Aid in the due diligence process of prospective companies when appropriate, by vetting the feasibility and defensibility of their AI & ML-powered products
  • Champion AI upskilling initiatives to increase brand self-sufficiency over time


Strategic Alignment

  • Act as a liaison between the brands and the group AI & Data function, serving as the single point of contact regarding AI & Data topics
  • Coordinate AI initiatives and roadmaps between and across the brands and with the group AI & Data function
  • Ensure alignment of brand AI initiatives with the group AI & Data strategy and priorities while respecting brand autonomy and growth path


Communication & Governance

  • Enable communication flows between the brands and group AI & Data function, ensuring alignment on priorities and supporting rapid decision making
  • Ensure visibility into brand AI & Data activities, timelines, and risks with regular strategic briefings, presentations and updates for executive stakeholders
  • Ensure visibility of group AI & Data resources and initiatives within the brands


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience shipping AI products to real end users and driving AI product innovation, ideally within the SaaS space
  • Strong technical background in AI & Data and understanding of AI and Data's strategic business potential and how to translate it into product features and initiatives
  • Experience shaping and managing product or AI & Data roadmaps in close collaboration with technical, product and commercial teams
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders in a matrixed environment
  • Skilled communicator, able to balance strategic alignment with local autonomy and business priorities
  • Comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels, with the ability to zoom in and out seamlessly, and work across technical and business teams
  • Structured, analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize complex inputs into actionable direction
  • Experience in post-merger integration or multi-brand strategy environments is a plus


"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

ESG

“At team.blue, our commitment to caring for the environment and each other is at the heart of everything we do. Our latest impact report showcases our ongoing ESG efforts and ambitious sustainability goals. Interested in learning more about our dedication to making a positive impact? Check it out here.”

The most trusted digital enabler

team.blue is a leading digital enabler for companies and entrepreneurs. It serves over 3.3 million customers in Europe and has more than 3,000 experts to support them. Its goal is to shape technology and to empower businesses with innovative digital services.

descriptionHtml:
Liderar a estratégia de produto da Loovi, garantindo a construção de soluções inovadoras que gerem valor para clientes e para o negócio, transformando oportunidades de mercado em produtos escaláveis, rentáveis e diferenciados.

Responsável por conectar visão estratégica e execução, promovendo uma cultura orientada por dados, experiência do cliente e impacto nos resultados da companhia.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto:

  • Definir e liderar a visão, estratégia e roadmap de produtos da companhia.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre produto, tecnologia, operações, comercial, marketing e experiência do cliente.
  • Identificar tendências de mercado, oportunidades de inovação e novos modelos de negócio.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos da companhia em iniciativas de produto com impacto mensurável.

Gestão do Portfólio

  • Liderar a evolução do portfólio de produtos e serviços da Loovi.
  • Definir prioridades com base em impacto para cliente, negócio e eficiência operacional.
  • Garantir o equilíbrio entre crescimento, rentabilidade, experiência do cliente e escalabilidade.
  • Acompanhar todo o ciclo de vida dos produtos, desde discovery até otimização contínua.

Experiencia do cliente

  • Ser a principal voz do cliente dentro da organização.
  • Promover uma cultura de pesquisa, validação e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Garantir experiências simples, intuitivas e alinhadas às necessidades dos usuários.
  • Utilizar dados e feedbacks para orientar decisões de produto.

Dados, Performance e Crescimento

  • Definir e acompanhar indicadores estratégicos de produto.
  • Utilizar dados para tomada de decisão e priorização de iniciativas.
  • Liderar processos de experimentação, testes e melhoria contínua.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento, retenção, engajamento e monetização.

Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Time

  • Estruturar, desenvolver e liderar o time de Produto.
  • Construir processos, rituais e governança da área.
  • Desenvolver uma cultura de alta performance, colaboração e senso de dono.
  • Influenciar decisões executivas por meio de análises, visão estratégica e profundo entendimento do negócio.

descriptionHtml:
Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better.

Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future.

Position Summary

The Head of AI Products is a leader responsible for owning the Enterprise AI product portfolio end to end, including AI product strategy, delivery, governance, and responsible deployment at scale.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining technical depth, product ownership, and people leadership. The Head of AI Products builds and leads a team of AI engineers and product-oriented practitioners while remaining actively involved in designing, building, and shipping AI products, particularly AI agents that reason, use tools, and execute end to end business workflows.

Success in this role is measured by AI products delivered and adopted, business outcomes achieved, and the establishment of a trusted, scalable AI governance framework that enables innovation while managing risk.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the enterprise AI product strategy and roadmap, aligning AI investments to strategic business priorities.
  • Reimagine enterprise workflows with an AI first product mindset, identifying and prioritizing high value opportunities for AI driven transformation.
  • Partner with executive and business leaders to frame ambiguous problems, quantify value, and translate opportunities into clear AI product hypotheses.
  • Define and own product KPIs for each AI product; track adoption, usage, and business impact post-launch, reporting outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  • Drive product discovery and validation through user research, prototyping, and structured experimentation before committing to full-scale build.
  • Embed MVP discipline into AI product delivery scope minimum viable releases, gather user feedback early, and iterate based on observed outcomes.
  • Serve as the voice of the internal customer, maintaining continuous feedback loops with business users to inform backlog priorities and product direction.
  • Provide dotted-line leadership to AI Agent Builders embedded within business functions, ensuring alignment to enterprise AI standards, architecture, governance, and delivery practices.
  • Define and maintain the operating model for how function-embedded Agent Builders collaborate with the central AI Products team including shared tooling, code standards, model selection guidelines, reusable components, and escalation paths.
  • Partner with functional leaders to scope Agent Builder roles, support hiring and onboarding, and ensure embedded talent is equipped to build and deploy AI agents that meet enterprise-grade quality and compliance requirements.
  • Own and lead AI governance across the enterprise, including policies, standards, guardrails, and operating models.
  • Establish and enforce Responsible AI practices, including model risk management, human-in-the-loop design, escalation paths, monitoring, and auditability, with specific attention to regulatory requirements in the pharmaceutical and MedTech space (e.g., FDA, HIPAA, GxP, and applicable data privacy regulations).
  • Remain actively hands on in designing and building AI products and agent based solutions.
  • Build and review AI agents using Python, LLM APIs, and modern agent frameworks that analyze information, call tools/APIs, and complete tasks end to end.
  • Ensure production ready delivery using enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure AI services), with strong security, observability, and reliability.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high performing AI Products team.
  • Foster a culture of product ownership, build first execution, and accountability.
  • Operate within Agile product delivery models, managing backlogs, iterative releases, and outcome-based prioritization.
  • Balance speed of innovation with enterprise grade quality, governance, and operational stability.
  • Lead AI product delivery within Agile frameworks, including ownership of product backlogs, sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, and sprint retrospectives.
  • Accountable for iterative, outcome-based delivery — managing scope, schedule, and quality across concurrent AI product workstreams.
  • Track team-level delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, release cadence) and drive continuous improvement in execution.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML, automation, or digital product delivery in enterprise environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying AI products, including LLM based systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical and product teams and delivering complex solutions at scale.
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business needs into shippable AI products.
  • Excellent executive communication skills and ability to influence across functions.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience owning AI governance frameworks (Responsible AI, model risk, security, compliance).
  • Deep familiarity with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure AI services, Foundry style platforms).
  • Experience with multi model / model garden approaches, selecting models based on quality, cost, latency, and risk.
  • Experience operating in regulated, complex, or global enterprises.
  • Background blending product leadership, consulting style problem solving, and hands on engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience operating in the pharmaceutical, MedTech, consumer health, or life sciences industry strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of AI agent architectures, orchestration, tool calling, and human in the loop design.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

For U.S. locations that require disclosure of compensation, the starting pay for this role is between $190,000.00 and $230,000.00. The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors.

U.S. based employees may be eligible for short-term and/or long-term incentives. They may also be eligible to participate in medical, dental, vision insurance, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, a tuition reimbursement program (select degrees), company holidays, and well-being benefits, among others. U.S. based employees are also eligible to receive sick time, floating holidays and paid vacation.

Job Applicants should be aware of job offer scams perpetrated through the use of the Internet and social media platforms.

To learn more please read Bausch + Lomb's Job Offer Fraud Statement .

Our Benefit Programs: Employee Benefits: Bausch + Lomb

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

descriptionHtml:
About Rezolve Ai

Rezolve Ai (NASDAQ: RZLV) is an industry leader in AI-powered solutions, specializing in enhancing customer engagement, operational efficiency, and revenue growth. The Brain Suite delivers advanced tools that harness artificial intelligence to optimize processes, improve decision-making, and enable seamless digital experiences

As a leader in Product Discovery, we empower retailers and brands with AI-driven search, conversational commerce, geofencing, and one-touch instant payments. With recent acquisitions of ViSenze, GroupBy and Bluedot, Rezolve is accelerating innovation at the intersection of AI, commerce, and customer engagement

About The Role

We are hiring an AI Product Manager to own the evaluation, quality, and safe deployment of AI across Rezolve’s Conversational Commerce platform.

You will define how LLMs and agentic systems are used in production, set guardrails and quality standards, and own go / no-go decisions for AI-driven changes. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams to ensure Conversational Commerce delivers trusted, enterprise-ready AI experiences.

This is a high-impact role with influence across product strategy, architecture, and execution.

Responsibilities

AI Product Ownership & Strategy

Own the evolution of AI capabilities within Conversational Commerce.

Define how conversational and agentic AI translate into differentiated customer value.

Partner with the Principal PM to shape roadmap priorities, sequencing, and trade-offs.

AI Evaluation, Quality & Decision Ownership

Own the AI evaluation strategy, including:

Success metrics

Experiments and analysis

Tying model performance to user and business outcomes

Define and track core AI quality metrics (e.g. task success, hallucinations, latency).

Own go / no-go decisions for AI changes (ship, rollback, iterate).

Clearly communicate impact, risk, and trade-offs to Product, Engineering, and Leadership.

Model Safety & Guardrails

Own LLM safety testing

Define and evolve guardrails to ensure safe, reliable AI behaviour.

Partner with engineering on grounding strategies, constraints, fallbacks, and escalation paths.

Ensure AI systems are observable and improve over time

Conversational & Multi-Agent Systems

Contribute to decisions on how LLMs are deployed across conversational flows.

Help shape the Conversational Commerce multi-agent framework, including:

Agent roles and responsibilities

Orchestration and task decomposition

Tool usage boundaries

Ensure agentic systems are testable, debuggable, and scalable.

Discovery & Execution

Lead continuous discovery through customer research, usage analysis, and feedback loops.

Validate that AI capabilities solve real, high-impact customer problems.

Translate AI strategy into clear requirements, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.

Enable fast execution without compromising quality or trust.

Essential

About You

4–7+ years in Product Management, Applied AI, or ML-adjacent roles

Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered systems in production.

Strong understanding of LLM failure modes, evaluation techniques, and mitigation strategies.

Comfortable making trade-offs across capability, cost, latency, and risk.

Clear, confident communicator across technical and non-technical teams.

First 6 months:

Clear AI evaluation and quality framework adopted across Conversational Commerce.

Defined guardrails and safety standards enforced in production.

Stable, observable conversational and agentic flows operating at scale.

Confident go / no-go decision-making for AI changes.

Strong alignment across Product, Engineering, AI, and Commercial teams.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director of Product Management, AI Evals
description: Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. descriptionHtml:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

AI is moving from experimentation to production faster than any technology shift in recent memory, and the teams shipping it are discovering that traditional software testing breaks down for LLM-powered systems. Evaluation is the missing layer, and it's becoming the bottleneck for enterprise AI adoption. Harness is uniquely positioned to solve this: we already sit at the center of how engineering teams ship software, with deep integration into CI/CD pipelines and trusted relationships with platform and developer teams at enterprises worldwide. The AI Evals module is our bet that evaluation belongs in the same pipeline as the rest of software delivery, not as a bolted-on tool. This role will define what that looks like.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to lead Harness's AI Evaluation module defining how engineering teams measure, validate, and continuously improve AI and LLM-powered applications in production. This role has end-to-end business ownership of our AI Evals module, including vision, strategy, and P&L

About The Role

  • Design AI-assisted experiences for eval authoring, failure analysis, and remediation recommendations.
  • Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and P&L for Harness's AI Evals module.
  • Partner with engineering to deliver scalable, differentiated solutions that developers love.
  • Work closely with GTM teams (sales, marketing, customer success) on positioning, adoption, and revenue growth.
  • Engage directly with customers to shape the roadmap, improve adoption, and ensure measurable business impact.
  • Drive competitive positioning and track product metrics

About You

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including AI/ML technologies, developer tooling, or platform products.
  • Experience owning business outcomes including strategy, positioning, and revenue impact.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, and GTM teams.
  • Obsessed with customer success and outcome-driven.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • LLM evaluation methodologies
    • CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows
    • AI observability, monitoring, and quality assurance
    • Agentic AI systems and the unique evaluation challenges they present
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI/ML evaluation or observability platforms at scale.
  • Experience in building products from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning pipelines, and dataset versioning.
  • Exposure to AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, or automated remediation.
  • Cloud-native and enterprise SaaS experience.

Work Location

  • Hybrid from Mountain View CA.

What you will have at Harness

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
  • Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
  • Monthly internet reimbursement

The anticipated base salary range for this position is between $265,000 and $280,000 annually. Salary is determined by a combination of factors including location, level, relevant experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. The compensation package for this position may also include equity, and benefits. More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.harness.io/company/careers.

Pay transparency

$265,000—$280,000 USD

Harness In The News

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

Job description:

Job Title:  International Head of AI Strategy and Operationalization

Corporate Title: Executive Director

Department: Group Technology

Location: Singapore

Licensed Role: No

Department Overview:

The Artificial Intelligence (AI) Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a dedicated, multi-disciplinary team that advises, builds, and scales AI solutions across Nomura's International Business. Acting as both the strategic engine and delivery arm for AI adoption, the AI CoE drives the responsible development and productionisation of AI capabilities — ensuring every initiative is aligned to business strategy, delivers measurable return on investment, and meets regulatory compliance standards.

 

Role Overview:

As the International Head of AI Strategy and Operationalisation (Executive Director) within the AI CoE, you will be responsible for facilitating and executing the firm’s AI Strategy and the successful adoption of AI solutions for Nomura’s International Business - this role combines strategic innovation and leadership with hands on AI delivery implementation. 

You will partner and collaborate with senior stakeholders across business lines and functions to shape the AI strategy, prioritise high impact initiatives, and oversee their progression from concept through to production.  The role requires a deep understanding of AI and emerging technologies, combined with a thorough understanding of what it takes to deploy them safely, compliantly, and sustainably within a global financial services institution.  You will be accountable for unlocking commercial value, strengthening operational efficiency, and enhancing risk management while ensuring alignment with governance standards.   

 

Role Description:

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Define and execute the AI strategy – in alignment with global and regional priorities.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to ideate and identify high-value AI use cases and opportunities – across both business lines and functions, balancing innovation with trust, governance, and regulatory expectations.
  • Shape the AI portfolio and contribute to the global AI use case portfolio and capability / product strategy.
  • Operate as a thought leader, ensuring industry best practice.

 

Innovation & Ideation

  • Lead ideation workshops, design sessions, and discovery engagements with business stakeholders to explore the art of the possible with AI.
  • Drive the incubation of new AI projects - that leverage GenAI, ML, NLP, predictive models, and agentic workflows.
  • Stay ahead of technology trends, market dynamics, regulatory developments (regional and local), and competitive activity.

 

Execution & Delivery

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of AI initiatives—from concept, experimentation, prototyping, and PoC/MVP builds through to production deployment and adoption – including the governance process.
  • Lead and collaborate with cross functional teams to drive AI initiatives, including data scientists, engineers, subject matter experts.  Act as the bridge between the technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Develop strategic roadmaps, project plans, timelines, milestones and success metrics.
  • Develop patterns, reusable components, enterprise architecture, and best practices.

 

AI Governance, Risk & Control

  • Ensure all AI initiatives meet internal AI governance, risk management, model validation, and regulatory requirements
  • Manage responsible AI processes, including documentation, testing, monitoring, transparency, and post-deployment controls – where required.
  • Support the implementation of global AI governance frameworks and provide feedback on gaps, risks, and enhancements.

 

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence

  • Build strong relationships with senior leadership across different business lines and functions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and collaborate on AI strategy, adoption, and execution for senior stakeholders.
  • Represent the organisation in industry forums, conferences, regulatory engagements, and ecosystem partnerships.
  • Leverage relationships with fintechs, third parties, and industry bodies to support the AI Strategy
  • Ensure consistent messaging and coordination across internal teams.

 

Capability Building & Operating Model

  • Develop AI capabilities, including talent, processes, training, and culture uplift (e.g., AI literacy, upskilling, innovation programmes).
  • Drive adoption of reusable components, and common frameworks to ensure scale, consistency, and reduced time-to-market.
  • Partner with HR, Learning, and Data/Tech leadership on skills development, role definition, and workforce transformation.
  • Lead education programmes and campaigns to increase AI maturity and capability

 

Skills, experience, qualifications, and knowledge required:

  • 14+ years’ experience in AI, data science, digital transformation, technology strategy, data strategy within financial services – from either a consulting background or in house strategy team
  • Proven experience working within a financial services institution, with exposure to front office business lines and/or corporate functions such as Risk, Compliance, Finance or Operations.   
  • Proven track record of taking AI solutions from ideation through PoC to production in a global organisation.
  • Experience engaging with regulators and participating in regulatory consultations
  • Strong understanding of GenAI, LLMs, and agentic systems
  • Understanding of AI governance frameworks, processes, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, translating complex AI concepts into business value and practical roadmaps.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams across regions and building AI capabilities that scale.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, with a focus on delivering high-quality results in a timely manner.
  • Experience in handling ambiguity and uncertainty, with the ability to navigate complex situations and make informed decisions
  • Understanding of how to manage the regulatory landscape in a global organisation.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas in a clear and concise manner (written and verbal) – must have strong MS Powerpoint and MS Excel skills
  • Ability to think strategically and develop innovative solutions
  • Strong understanding of data and AI concepts such as data management, data governance, AI risks etc.
  • Passion for learning and growing in the field of data and AI
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Engineering, and/or MBA with strong technical literacy.

Firm Overview

H.I.G. Capital is a leading global private equity investment firm with $75 billion of assets under management with a focus on the mid cap segment of the market. The H.I.G. family of funds includes private equity, growth equity, real estate, direct lending, special situation credit, and growth-stage healthcare. We focus on providing capital to businesses with attractive growth potential and align ourselves with committed management teams and entrepreneurs to help grow businesses of significant value. Our team of over 500 investment professionals has substantial operating, consulting, technology, and financial management experience, enabling us to contribute meaningfully to our portfolio companies. H.I.G. is based in Miami, with offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, New York, and San Francisco, and affiliate offices in Hamburg, London, Luxembourg, Madrid, Milan, and Paris in Europe as well as Bogotá, Rio de Janeiro, and São Paulo in Latin America, Dubai in the Middle East, and Hong Kong in Asia.

Role Overview

H.I.G. Capital is hiring a Director, AI Enablement to execute the firm's AI strategy for investment professionals and front-office staff. The role owns ACE (Advanced Context Engine), H.I.G.'s proprietary single-pane-of-glass AI platform, and is accountable for the scalable architecture, roadmap, systems integration, agent development, and adoption work required to translate AI capability into measurable gains in productivity, deal velocity, and decision quality. The Director will set platform direction in close partnership with firm leadership, including the CTO, the GenAI Steering Committee, the Managing Director of Commercial and Digital, deal team leadership, and the AI Training and Development function.

Role Responsibilities

ACE Platform Architecture and Roadmap:

  • Oversee the scalable architecture and product roadmap for ACE in partnership with the CTO and firm leadership
  • Translate front-office workflows into platform requirements, release plans, and reliability and performance targets
  • Manage vendor and partner relationships supporting the platform and represent H.I.G. with strategic AI providers

Systems Integration

  • Lead data, MCP, and connector integration across deal sourcing, CRM, research, document management, and portfolio reporting systems
  • Establish reusable integration patterns, evaluation harnesses, and governance for new connections
  • Partner with IT, InfoSec, and Data teams on architecture, access controls, and data lineage

Bot And Agent Development Prioritization

  • Maintain a prioritized backlog of bots, agents, and skills with explicit ROI hypotheses and success metrics
  • Direct internal and partner development resources against the highest-value front-office workflows
  • Set quality, evaluation, observability, and rollback standards prior to release

Investment Professional Adoption And Enablement

  • Drive adoption across investment professionals through workflow integration, white-glove support, and embedded enablement
  • Define and report on usage, impact, and quality metrics by team and workflow
  • Partner with the Director of AI Training and Development on capability building and the GenAI Champions network
  • Surface portfolio-relevant patterns to the Operating Partner team where appropriate

Cross-Firm Coordination And Governance

  • Coordinate with the GenAI Steering Committee, Champions network, and senior firm leadership on direction and trade-offs
  • Contribute to AI governance, acceptable use, and skills policy

Requirements & Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of combined experience across product management, applied AI deployment, and enterprise software, including at least 3 years leading AI or platform initiatives at scale
  • Demonstrated track record shipping AI or agent products in production with measurable business impact
  • Strong technical fluency in LLM tooling (Anthropic, OpenAI), retrieval, agent frameworks, MCP, and enterprise integration patterns
  • Experience driving adoption of new technology with senior, demanding professional users
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and executive presence

Preferred

  • Prior experience in private equity, asset management, or other financial services
