descriptionHtml:
The MLB Product team is seeking an experienced Director to lead the delivery, evolution, integrations, and operational excellence of MLB’s fan activation and marketing technology platforms. This role sits within the Fan Data Platform Product organization, which is responsible for unifying MLB fan data, enabling a 360-degree fan view, and building scalable data and technology foundations that support analytics, personalization, marketing activation, and other league-wide functions.

This role is a hands-on product leader with a deep understanding of data governance, marketing technologies, and tool integration responsible for translating business and marketing requirements into durable, well-architected platform capabilities. The Director of MarTech Product & Enablement partners closely with Marketing, Engineering, and Analytics teams to shape MarTech system design, prioritize platform enhancements, and build scalable capabilities that power meaningful fan engagement and personalized experiences for millions of fans worldwide.

Responsibilities

MarTech Platform Ownership & Delivery

  • Own the delivery, integration, and ongoing evolution of MLB’s Marketing Technology platforms, ensuring seamless operations across channels and data flows
  • Serve as the primary product owner and subject matter expert for MarTech platforms, partnering with Engineering to design scalable solutions, manage technical tradeoffs, and prioritize platform enhancements
  • Partner with Marketing teams to translate business and activation requirements into durable, well-architected platform capabilities focusing on innovation and strategic fit
  • Identify and advance opportunities to modernize and improve MarTech platforms through new capabilities, architectural enhancements, and emerging technologies, balancing innovation with reliability and scalability

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to gather requirements, define system behaviors, and ensure MarTech solutions meet functional and technical needs
  • Partner with 30 Club’s Marketing, Data, and Analytics teams to enable adoption of centralized MarTech capabilities, support Club-level use cases, and balance league-wide standards with local needs

Data Governance & Compliance

  • Own the documentation and enablement of fan consent workflows, including Opt-In and Opt-Out processes, across marketing channels and platforms
  • Partner with Legal, Data Engineering, and Information Security teams to ensure MarTech systems and data flows comply with applicable privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, state-specific requirements) and MLB privacy policies
  • Drive clear documentation, operational standards, and governance practices for MarTech-related data flows and system dependencies

Tracking, Measurement, & Attribution

  • Own the foundational attribution and measurement infrastructure that supports marketing performance analysis, including standardized data models, nomenclature, implementation patterns, and quality assurance practices
  • Manage linking infrastructure (e.g., deep links, short URLs), and data capture patterns ensuring fan calls to action generate tracked events that can be reliably tracked through to conversion
  • Maintain data ownership over attribution datasets, ensuring tracking methodologies (e.g., Adobe-based tracking, breakout pixels) are well understood, consistently implemented, and appropriately interpreted by downstream teams

Qualifications & Skills

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Marketing Technology, MarTech integrations, or a related technical role
  • Deep familiarity with the implementation, integration, and ongoing operational management of enterprise-level MarTech solutions
  • Hands-on experience partnering with Engineering teams on system design and leading cross-functional projects with Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Experience with consent management, data privacy, and governance related to marketing data flows
  • Familiarity with marketing channel technologies for Email, SMS, Push, Paid Media, and Journey orchestration
  • Proficiency in SQL, with the ability to query, validate, and troubleshoot in large datasets
  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), including Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) or similar tools
  • Strong understanding of tracking, linking management, and attribution data concepts
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional manner for interfacing with executives and non-technical stakeholders across departments

Salary Range: $170,000 - 200,000 (Base Salary) + Bonus

As a candidate for this position, your salary and related aspects of compensation will be contingent upon your work experience, education, skills, and any other factors MLB considers relevant to the hiring decision. In addition to your salary, MLB believes in providing a competitive compensation and benefits package for its employees.

Top MLB Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive Benefits Package
  • Company Contributed 401K Plan
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Access to Free Tickets to Baseball Games & MLB.TV
  • Discounts at MLB Store | MLBShop.com
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
  • Onsite/Online Training & Development Programs
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Disability Benefits (short term and long term)
  • Life and Accidental Death Insurance
  • Pet Insurance

Why MLB?

Major League Baseball (MLB) is the most historic of the major professional sports leagues in the United States and Canada. Employees love working at MLB because of the culture of growth, teamwork, and professionalism. Employees who are most successful at MLB take initiative, know how to identify problems and provide solutions, and always put the Team first. For those ready to step up to the plate and join the major leagues, MLB takes the same approach as teams do with their players: empowering our “workforce athletes” to be at their best by engineering experiences that put employees in the best position to succeed. Major League Baseball is looking for candidates who are passionate about growing America’s pastime to best serve its fans for decades to come.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

team.blue is an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group; within those brands, 4.000 experts serve its 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses, offering services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce and server hosting solutions and specialist SaaS providers offering adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position Overview

As Head of SaaS AI, you will be responsible for enabling AI Product innovation of our SaaS brands, and aligning their AI initiatives and product roadmaps with the overall team.blue AI & Data strategy.

You will support the brands in creating and executing their AI & Data product roadmaps and initiatives, driving the use of AI & ML in their products and supporting AI & Data product development.

This role will act as the key liaison between the central group AI & Data function and the brands, driving collaboration, and enabling shared AI & Data value creation across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Product Innovation

  • Partner with brands to identify and develop innovative AI products, use cases and initiatives that create business value
  • Design AI solution architectures and flow patterns that align technical possibilities with business stakeholder needs
  • Shape the creation and execution of brand AI product roadmaps and drive AI product innovation to support brand growth priorities and group priorities


Technical Guidance & Support

  • Act as a sounding board for the brand product teams as they build AI products, advising and guiding them and sharing your knowledge of AI & Data advances
  • Support fast development of AI products and initiatives by coordinating access to the group AI & Data teams and resources
  • Aid in the due diligence process of prospective companies when appropriate, by vetting the feasibility and defensibility of their AI & ML-powered products
  • Champion AI upskilling initiatives to increase brand self-sufficiency over time


Strategic Alignment

  • Act as a liaison between the brands and the group AI & Data function, serving as the single point of contact regarding AI & Data topics
  • Coordinate AI initiatives and roadmaps between and across the brands and with the group AI & Data function
  • Ensure alignment of brand AI initiatives with the group AI & Data strategy and priorities while respecting brand autonomy and growth path


Communication & Governance

  • Enable communication flows between the brands and group AI & Data function, ensuring alignment on priorities and supporting rapid decision making

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

About Semarchy

Semarchy was founded in 2011 in Lyon, France, by a team of passionate data experts with a clear mission: modernizing master data management. Over the years, we’ve expanded our capabilities into Data Management, Integration, and Intelligence, building a unified design experience that accelerates revenue growth, modernizes workflows, and boosts enterprise AI initiatives.

Headquartered in Arizona, USA, with global offices across France, the UK, and India, Semarchy serves over 400 clients worldwide, including Fortune 500 leaders. Trusted by industry innovators, our adaptive, modular approach helps organizations achieve data-driven success in as fast as 12 weeks.

About The Role

Semarchy’s Snowflake Native App achieved proven product-market fit in Year One of the partnership, with multiple enterprise wins already on the books. Rapid growth in pipeline, awareness, and interest — combined with the joint Semarchy/Snowflake roadmap — is creating a major scaling opportunity for 2026 and beyond.

The Sr. Director, Product and Technology Partnerships is a unique hybrid leadership role that sits at the intersection of product and partnerships. You will own two tightly connected missions: driving deep technical and product alignment with our strategic technology partners — initially with Snowflake and Microsoft — and driving product management for Semarchy’s Snowflake-native solutions so that our roadmap and our partners’ platforms advance together as one strategy.

This role is strictly focused on technical alignment with partners — product roadmaps, platform capabilities, integrations, and joint solution architecture — not on commercial or sales plays, which are owned by our alliance and sales teams. That said, you must bring strong commercial savvy: an understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales so that technical alignment translates into market impact.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer, with a dotted-line relationship to the Head of Product Management (based in France) for your product management responsibilities. Snowflake is our most mature partnership and the immediate priority, with Microsoft — where our technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — as the second strategic focus. Beyond these, this role owns Semarchy’s broader technology partnership strategy and will explore potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role to start, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as the partnership portfolio scales. It is built for someone with high agency: a builder who creates structure, drives follow-through, and earns the trust of partner product and engineering organizations.

Location: USA, remote, in the Central or Eastern time zone. You will collaborate daily with our product and engineering teams in France and coordinate regularly with technology partners primarily based in the western USA, so working hours that bridge both are essential.

Job Requirements

Must Have

  • 10+ years in enterprise software, including 5+ years in technical partnerships, partner engineering, solutions leadership, or product management roles within cloud ecosystems.
  • Proven success driving technical and product alignment with one or more of: Snowflake, Microsoft/Azure, or other major cloud data platforms.
  • Hands-on product management experience: gathering requirements, writing specifications, managing a backlog, and partnering with engineering to ship.
  • Deep working knowledge of the modern data stack (cloud data platforms, data management, integration, or analytics).
  • Commercial savvy: a strong understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales teams.
  • Comfortable operating across technology, product, and executive relationships, including with senior partner product and engineering leaders.
  • Strong program management skills and high agency — driven to get things done; elite communication and soft skills, including the ability to translate technical depth for commercial audiences.
  • Based in the US Central or Eastern time zone, with the flexibility to overlap with teams in France (mornings) and partners on the US West Coast (afternoons); willingness to travel (~25%) for partner meetings, customer engagements, and industry events.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with Snowflake Native Apps, Snowpark, or building solutions on the Snowflake Marketplace.
  • Experience with the Microsoft Partner ecosystem and marketplaces.
  • Domain expertise in master data management (MDM), data integration, data products, semantic intelligence.
  • Experience working in a globally distributed organization across US and European time zones; French language skills are a plus.
  • Experience building and leading partner engineering or product teams.

Job Responsibilities

Technology Partnership Strategy & Technical Alignment (initially with Snowflake and Microsoft)

  • Define and own Semarchy’s technology partnership strategy, exploring and prioritizing potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.
  • Own the technical relationship with our strategic technology partners: lead roadmap discussions, technical alignment, and advanced configuration conversations with partner product and engineering counterparts.
  • Ensure Semarchy capitalizes early on new Snowflake platform capabilities, and that our Native App strategy stays ahead of the Snowflake roadmap.
  • Deepen technical alignment with Microsoft — where Semarchy’s technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — including integration architecture, platform certifications, and marketplace technical requirements.
  • Build relationships with partner engineering, partner technical, and ISV teams to establish Semarchy’s technical credibility on each platform.
  • Establish and maintain joint technical escalation paths with Support and Professional Services for pre/post-sales support and joint problem resolution.
  • Serve as the technical voice of the partnerships in reviews with Semarchy leadership.
  • Establish the repeatable playbook — technical evaluation, product integration, roadmap alignment — that future technology partnerships will follow.
  • As the portfolio scales, help define the team needed to support it, with the opportunity to hire and lead.

Product Management

  • Drive product management for Semarchy’s partner-aligned solutions — expanding our Snowflake-aligned capabilities and our alignment with Microsoft Fabric — working day-to-day with the Head of Product Management and engineering teams in France.
  • Gather and synthesize requirements from customers, partners, partner field teams, analysts, and competitive intelligence into a prioritized roadmap for the Snowflake Native App and related capabilities.
  • Produce specifications, refine and organize the product backlog, and partner with engineering to deliver high-value features and product iterations.
  • Champion the solutions internally and externally — with customers, partners, analysts, and field teams — and feed their input back into product strategy and positioning.

Cross-Functional & GTM Collaboration

  • Work closely with product marketing and marketing to ensure positioning, launch content, and partner-facing assets accurately reflect joint technical capabilities.
  • Support sales and alliance teams as the technical authority on partner platforms — helping them understand what is possible, what is roadmapped, and how joint solutions are architected.
  • Partner with enablement teams to develop technically accurate training, demos, and assets for internal teams and partner field organizations.
  • Ensure Snowflake, Microsoft, and Semarchy owners are connected across Product Management, Support, and Professional Services, and keep Product, GTM, and Operations working against one shared partner plan.

What Success Looks Like

  • Snowflake and Microsoft product and engineering teams know exactly who owns the technical relationship with Semarchy.
  • The Snowflake solutions roadmap is visibly shaped by partner and customer input, and product releases land in sync with partner platform milestones and joint GTM motions.
  • Sales, marketing, and alliance teams have a trusted technical authority on partner platforms — joint solutions are well-architected and well-understood.
  • Product, GTM, and Operations work against one shared partner plan.

Job Benefits

We are committed to making Semarchy an even better place to work, and this means creating a high performing environment where everyone can do their Best Work, where they can Grow in their career path, and Be Accountable – to each other and Semarchy.

  • For those applicants in the CA, CO and NYC area, the salary range for this role is $__K to $__K base plus variable incentive. The salary offered will be based on experience, role, and location.

Semarchy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer (EEO) that celebrates difference and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We are committed to building an inclusive work environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and respect. If there is anything we can do to ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

Location Details: United States, Remote


At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.


This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.


GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.


Join our team

At GoDaddy, we empower entrepreneurs and small businesses around the world to succeed online. With more than 20 million customers — most of them first-time or early-stage sellers — we sit at a scale that no pure-play SaaS FinTech can match. And our top-of-funnel is dramatically under invested relative to that installed base. That's the opportunity.


We are seeing a Senior Director Product Management (Risk and Onboarding) to join our team! This role leads strategy and execution across lead generation, conversion, merchandising, and AI-powered sales enablement — the full front door of our Commerce platform. The person who builds this capability will compose how millions of entrepreneurs first experience GoDaddy Commerce. They will also define the growth motion that compounds across every segment we serve.


You'll drive measurable revenue impact by coordinating product, sales, promotional efforts, go-to-market, and engineering partners around a unified growth strategy. You'll lead a team building the capabilities that turn visitors into customers and help our sales teams work smarter, faster, and more efficiently!


What you'll get to do...

  • Own the entire top-of-funnel experience for AI (sales representative for Airo) first products. This includes the first customer touch, lead conversion, and handoff to sales.
  • Drive GPV growth, conversion rate improvement, and sales efficiency through product-led and sales-assisted growth initiatives
  • Define and own success metrics across the funnel — visitor-to-lead rate, lead-to-close rate, CAC, and revenue contribution — with clear accountability at every stage
  • Identify and prioritize the highest-impact growth opportunities across paid acquisition, merchandising, experimentation, and sales enablement
  • Build and maintain a rigorous experimentation program: split testing, multivariate tests, and iterative optimization informed by real SMB customer behavior Experimentation, Intelligence & AI Enablement
  • Treat data and experimentation as infrastructure — own the team's relationship with attribution, CDP, and experimentation platforms (Statsig, Optimizely, or equivalent)
  • Lead development and deployment of advanced capabilities like Airo Sales Agent, prospect ranking, tailored customer interactions, intelligent routing, and workflow automation. These features are applied to develop measurable lift instead of functioning as standalone elements.
  • Partner closely with Sales leadership to understand difficulties and translate them into high-impact product solutions
  • Ensure ML and data capabilities are instrumented, evaluated, and iterated on with the same rigor as any other product surfaceCross-Functional Orchestration
  • Align Sales, Marketing, GTM, Development, and Technical teams to shared goals, roadmaps, and success metrics
  • Translate business outcomes (conversion, return on investment, efficiency) into clear product direction and implementation plans
  • Navigate competing priorities and tradeoffs, balancing near-term revenue goals with long-term platform investments
  • Act as connective tissue across groups within a matrixed environment — driving progress even without direct ownership Team Leadership & Product Excellence
  • Lead and develop a high-performing product organization focused on growth outcomes, experimentation, and rapid learning
  • Coach leaders and ICs to operate as growth operators, not feature factories
  • Establish clear priorities in an opportunity-rich, fast paced environment
  • Build a culture of data-driven decision-making, accountability, and continuous improvement


Your experience should include...

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with 5+ years leading product teams at the Director or Senior Director level
  • Proven success owning top-of-funnel, growth, or product areas passionate about growing conversions. This includes measurable impact on conversion rate, CAC, lead quality, and revenue—ideally in a sales-assisted or hybrid PLG/sales motion.
  • Hands-on experience with modern experimentation infrastructure — A/B testing platforms(Statsig, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, or equivalent), attribution modeling, and CDPs
  • Direct experience shipping or scaling AI-powered growth tools: lead scoring, personalization engines, automation, or conversational AI at production scale and strong experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional environments, aligning Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering around shared outcomes
  • Proven success working with and managing complex initiatives within CRM tools, such as Salesforce.
  • Technical fluency with APIs, data platforms, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural tradeoffs —you can go deep with engineering partners without needing to write the code
  • Deeply data-driven outlook: you run experiments, know the difference between statistical significance and business significance, and can tell the story in both directions


You might also have...

  • Prior experience in SMB, commerce, or marketplace products — you understand that our customers are entrepreneurs, not enterprise procurement teams
  • Experience leading product at a company navigating the transition from inside sales to product-led growth
  • Strong people leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-impact product teams in a Bay Area talent market


We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.


At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.


We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.


GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.


Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. descriptionHtml:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.

We're looking for a Head of Product to rethink our products and fraud systems to be AI-centric. You'll leverage AI for automation and enable intuitive, multi-modal customer interactions to build trust and streamline compliance processes.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Leading a financial crime product team, designing features that improve security across Revolut’s global platform
  • Building teams to align with product objectives and developing team members to enable their career growth
  • Overseeing your team's product roadmap, from strategic planning and conception, to execution and launch.

What You'll Need

  • 7+ years of product management experience
  • 3+ years of experience managing large teams (product leaders at Revolut directly manage multiple squads and Product Owners)
  • Experience managing AI products, data science products, customer-facing products, and back office systems
  • Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
  • High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
  • A bias towards action and bootstrapping major projects, never hesitating to roll up your sleeves and be hands-on
  • Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
  • The ability to provide insight and deliver measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly entrepreneurial and technically strong Head of Product & Commercialisation to lead an AI-enabled B2B SaaS platform in the ESG, Sustainability, and LegalTech space. The product is already live, funded, and solving emerging challenges across large digital platforms.

This is a founder-facing leadership role with end-to-end ownership of product strategy, technical product direction, commercialization, partnerships, and go-to-market execution. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping product vision, driving adoption, and preparing the business for scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and drive product strategy, roadmap, positioning, packaging, and commercialization.
  • Lead product innovation through customer discovery, market research, and feature ideation.
  • Define and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies and product launches.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to define technical requirements, APIs, integrations, workflows, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and execution plans.
  • Build relationships with ecosystem partners, agencies, and strategic stakeholders.
  • Leverage customer feedback, market insights, and product data to drive decision-making.
  • Support business growth, market expansion, and long-term scaling initiatives.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS or Enterprise Software environments.
  • Proven experience building, launching, or scaling SaaS platforms or technology products.
  • Strong Technical Product Management experience, including APIs, integrations, workflows, platform products, and data-driven solutions.
  • Experience owning product strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, and product lifecycle management.
  • Experience with product launches, GTM strategy, commercialization, and market adoption.
  • Mandatory ESG and Sustainability domain experience.
  • Proven experience working with ESG reporting, Sustainability platforms, ESG ratings, Governance frameworks, Compliance solutions, or related ESG-focused products.
  • Strong customer discovery, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work directly with founders and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced, and ambiguous environments.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or intelligent workflow platforms.
  • Experience with LegalTech, RegTech, ComplianceTech, Governance, Risk, or regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or merchant-facing products.
  • Background in product marketing, pricing strategy, partnerships, or international product launches.


Why Consider This Opportunity

  • Founder-level ownership and influence.
  • Product already live and funded — not an idea-stage startup.
  • Opportunity to build and scale an AI-powered ESG & Sustainability SaaS platform.
  • Small, focused team with significant growth potential.
  • Direct impact on product direction, commercialization, and company growth.


About YMinds.AI

YMinds.AI is a specialist talent partner helping startups and high-growth companies hire exceptional talent across Product, Engineering, AI, Data, and Digital functions.


Keywords

Head of Product, Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, B2B SaaS, Product Strategy, Product Roadmap, GTM, Commercialisation, ESG, Sustainability, ESG Reporting, Enterprise Software, AI Products, LegalTech, RegTech


Hashtags

#HeadOfProduct #ProductManagement #TechnicalProductManager #B2BSaaS #ProductStrategy #Commercialisation #ESG #Sustainability #AIProducts #LegalTech #RegTech #Hiring

The successful candidate will lead the development of a high-performing community of professionals, ensuring clear career pathways, best-in-class ways of working, and a strong focus on value-driven delivery. Working closely with senior stakeholders across product, technology, and business functions, they will play a key role in workforce planning, capability development, and organisational effectiveness.

Capability Development

Strategic Workforce Planning

  • Develop and maintain workforce plans to ensure the right skills and resources are available to support delivery priorities.
  • Shape long-term capability and resourcing strategies across product and change functions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to optimise resource allocation and utilisation.
  • Support organisational design and operating model initiatives.


Performance, Outcomes & Value Delivery

  • Define and monitor performance measures to demonstrate effectiveness, efficiency, and business value.
  • Champion outcome-focused delivery and decision-making.
  • Drive continuous improvement across Product Owner and Business Analyst practices.
  • Ensure teams remain focused on delivering measurable business outcomes.


Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven experience leading Product Owners, Business Analysts, or similar change and delivery professionals.
  • Demonstrable experience building, developing, and maturing professional capabilities or Communities of Practice.
  • Strong experience implementing best-practice frameworks and ways of working.
  • Experience leading capability, operating model, or organisational design initiatives.
  • Strong background in product and programme delivery within complex environments.

descriptionHtml:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.

Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.

Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

The Director of Applied Intelligence Products Portfolio plays a pivotal role in advancing Huron’s Healthcare Insights portfolio by shaping, scaling, and activating a unified cross-domain analytics platform. This role sits at the intersection of product management, healthcare domain expertise, and consulting technology enablement, with a focus on driving value from insights that span revenue cycle, clinical, operational, and growth practice areas.

Rather than owning a single solution area, this role is responsible for cross-domain value creation: identifying high-impact use cases that require data, context, and capabilities from multiple domains; curating those opportunities into repeatable patterns; and translating the most valuable patterns into shared platform and experience layer capabilities, product frameworks, and client solutions.

The Director partners closely with consulting teams, domain product and capability owners, and platform architects to ensure the platform accelerates consulting delivery today while laying additional groundwork for repeatable, scalable, AI-enabled subscription offerings as these capabilities mature.

This is a highly collaborative, influence-driven role ideal for a product leader who can synthesize healthcare challenges, commercialize opportunities, and translate platform capabilities into clear value streams for Huron and its clients.

Key Responsibilities

Stakeholder Alignment & Product Leadership

  • Serve as a connective leader across platform teams, domain product owners, data science, and consulting stakeholders.
  • Facilitate structured conversations around prioritization, tradeoffs, and sequencing, particularly where cross-domain dependencies exist.
  • Communicate platform value and common frameworks in language that resonates with diverse audiences, from technical teams to healthcare executives and consulting partners.
  • Socialize platform progress, wins, learnings, and new opportunities to senior leadership, reinforcing momentum, clarity of direction, and leverage from investments.
  • Represent portfolio and platform capabilities in cross-domain planning forums, ensuring domain product leaders understand what is available today or in the near term, how it should be used, and how feedback informs future roadmap decisions.

Consulting Partnership & Methodology Enablement

  • Partner with consulting leadership and delivery teams across domains to design and support cross-domain pilot engagements that leverage shared platform and data assets.
  • Use these engagements to prove new insight-led consulting methodologies, validate repeatable delivery patterns, and generate evidence of differentiated outcomes and client value.
  • Partner with consulting leads to translate successful engagement patterns into reusable delivery playbooks, consultant enablement materials, inputs to future leave-behind and subscription-based offerings, and opportunities to expand technology revenue streams alongside consulting revenue.
  • Support alignment between capabilities and consulting motions, ensuring platform investments reinforce Huron’s consulting-first go-to-market strategy while also creating pathways to recurring managed services and technology-based revenue streams.

Cross-Domain Use Case Curation & Governance

  • Identify, triage, and curate cross-domain analytics and AI use cases that address complex healthcare challenges and cannot be solved within a single solution area.
  • Evaluate use cases through both impact and commercial lenses, including their potential to improve consulting outcomes and delivery efficiency, enable cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and serve as candidates for future productization or subscription offerings.
  • Maintain a living, prioritized portfolio of cross-domain opportunities that informs platform roadmap discussions, consulting pilots, delivery methodology evolution, and investment decisions.
  • Partner with domain leaders to ensure use cases are grounded in real healthcare workflows, client pain points, success criteria, and data realities.

Portfolio & Platform Capability Roadmap Ownership

  • Identify recurring patterns across curated use cases that signal the need for shared platform capabilities, such as semantic services, agent orchestration rails, reusable analytic services, and common context layers.
  • Shepherd these opportunities from concept through validation by defining the platform-level problem to be solved, intended consumers, and success measures.
  • Work with platform, architecture, and engineering partners to frame these capabilities as enablement assets rather than domain-specific features, balancing guardrails with flexibility.
  • Own portfolio and platform capability priorities, working in lockstep with domain teams and the Platform Architect to ensure technical direction and product value remain tightly aligned.
  • Serve as the Product Manager for shared platform capabilities, with accountability for defining the problem space, value proposition, experience layers, and success criteria for capabilities intended to support multiple Healthcare Insights domains.
  • Partner closely with the Platform Architect to translate cross-domain needs into a clear platform capability roadmap, define capability boundaries and dependencies, and ensure alignment between product intent and long-term platform scalability.
  • Review technical architecture and plans with the Lead Architect to ensure business needs are met and technical tradeoffs are understood in the context of fiscal responsibility.
  • Lead capability discovery and definition, including framing platform-level requirements, distinguishing what belongs in the platform versus what should remain domain-specific, and defining standards and guardrails that enable domain teams to build faster and more consistently.
  • Partner with the Architect acting as Technical Product Owner for portfolio-level and platform capabilities where appropriate, including owning high-level epics, prioritizing work, and partnering with delivery leads to ensure clarity of intent and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure portfolio and platform capabilities are designed as enablement assets, with clear guidance on intended users, usage and reuse patterns, integration expectations, and success measures tied to adoption and acceleration of domain delivery.
  • Continuously assess capabilities in market and in practice, using feedback from domain teams and consulting engagements to refine scope, roadmap, and investment decisions.

Execution & Continuous Learning

  • Partner with delivery and domain portfolio teams to ensure curated opportunities move forward with clarity, ownership, and momentum.
  • Participate in backlog and planning discussions as needed across capabilities, domains, and platform teams.
  • Use feedback from pilots, usage, and consulting teams to continuously refine use-case prioritization and platform direction.

Qualifications

Experience & Background

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, strategy, consulting, or a related role focused on data, analytics, platforms, or healthcare solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience working across multiple domains or portfolios rather than within a single product or functional area.
  • Background in healthcare analytics, healthcare consulting, or health-tech platforms strongly preferred.

Core Strengths

  • Strong ability to synthesize complex healthcare challenges into clear opportunity statements and product narratives.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a bias toward structured thinking, prioritization, and learning through pilots.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals.
  • Working understanding and experience with modern data and analytics concepts, including data platforms, semantic layers, AI/ML, and analytics products, without requiring deep hands-on technical ownership.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to engage credibly with consultants, product leaders, architects, and executives.
  • Comfort translating between healthcare, consulting, and product perspectives.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Advanced degree (MBA, MPH, Health Informatics, Data Science) preferred.

The estimated base salary for this job is $175,000 - $245,000 USD. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $218,750 - $330,750 USD. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Head of Product and Planning

Location: Slough with hybrid working and regional travel required

Salary: Competitive with excellent benefits


This role sits at the heart of an exciting joint venture between Jameel Motors and GAC, established to introduce the AION range of intelligent electrified vehicles to the UK market.


As part of the team, you will play a defining role in establishing and shaping the AION product strategy in the UK, ensuring the portfolio reflects the innovation, intelligence and ambition behind the brand.


The Head of Product and Planning is more than a leadership role; it is an opportunity to directly influence how a new automotive brand is positioned, launched and grown within a highly competitive and rapidly evolving market.


Find out more and follow us on AION Auto UK’s LinkedIn page.


About the Role


As Head of Product and Planning, you will take ownership of the UK product strategy end-to-end, leading the development, positioning and lifecycle management of AION’s model line-up.


This is a highly strategic and hands on role that blends deep market insight with commercial acumen and strong execution. You will translate complex data, competitive intelligence and customer insight into clear product direction, compelling messaging and actionable plans that drive commercial outcomes.


Working closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, PR and senior leadership, as well as international stakeholders, you will ensure the UK product offering is competitive, compliant and aligned with both global strategy and local market expectations. You will also lead and develop a Product Manager, ensuring delivery against key milestones and business objectives.


Key Responsibilities


  • Set UK pricing and positioning for current and future models, using competitor benchmarking to identify opportunities, risks and optimal market placement.
  • Lead the full product lifecycle, from market analysis and business case development through to launch planning and ongoing performance management.
  • Define UK product localisation requirements, ensuring specifications, trim levels and option structures meet regulatory requirements and customer expectations.
  • Collaborate with international teams, including GAC and research and development functions, to influence product development and ensure alignment to UK market needs.
  • Oversee sales channel strategy, including retail, fleet and motability, defining pricing structures and financial offers to support margin and competitiveness.
  • Support residual value setting through coordination with sales leadership and third-party valuation guides.
  • Ensure homologation and compliance requirements are met for all UK market introductions.
  • Lead launch planning activity, aligning cross functional stakeholders and ensuring readiness across all phases from pre-launch through to market introduction.
  • Use advanced data analysis to generate clear, compelling insights that inform business planning, strategy and stakeholder decision making.
  • Partner with Marketing and Public Relations teams to track and report on campaign performance, ensuring product messaging is clear, consistent and impactful.
  • Lead and develop the Product Manager while overseeing external support to ensure delivery, organisation and results.


Skills & Experience


  • Proven experience in a senior product or planning role within the automotive industry.
  • Strong product knowledge and understanding of the UK automotive market, including competitive landscape and customer dynamics.
  • Demonstrable experience of launching new models and ideally new brands into the UK market.
  • Excellent analytical capability, with advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to translate data into clear, compelling messaging.
  • Experience working with international or overseas teams, influencing stakeholders across different markets and functions.
  • Commercially focused, with a strong understanding of sales channels, pricing structures and finance models.
  • Confident communicator, able to articulate strategy, influence decisions and drive alignment at all levels.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast paced, evolving environment, combining strategic oversight with hands on delivery and a focus on outcomes.


What We Offer


  • Opportunity to shape and lead the future product roadmap of a major new automotive brand in the UK
  • Play a visible role in the launch and growth of AION in a highly dynamic market
  • Competitive compensation package, including a company car scheme
  • Hybrid working model
  • Health and wellbeing support through our partnership with the automotive charity BEN

description: Why join usBrex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.Product at BrexThe Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We are responsible for aligning cross-functional teams — such as Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design — on key decisions. We set strategy and drive products from inception to launch, enabling Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.What You’ll DoAs a Product Leader at Brex, you will be the driving force behind our Growth Product team — overseeing the thoughtful strategy and execution of team and technical systems to drive customer acquisition and onboarding. You will also collaborate closely with our Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure seamless acquisition and onboarding for customers, particularly those with significant and complex spending needs. You will be instrumental in creating features, models, and tools that empower our GTM and Marketing teams to get maximal leverage out of their efforts. You will work closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, based in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Vancouver, Brazil, and remote locations. Past examples of work in this domain include AI agents for GTM workflows, developing best-in-class GTM data and enrichment systems, ML models for account prioritization, prospect AI classification systems, and more.Where you’ll workThis role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least 3 days per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.ResponsibilitiesDrive product and systems investments that improve GTM metrics such as CAC payback, pipeline conversion, and efficiency.Define and execute a multi-quarter Growth strategy in partnership with Engineering, Design, GTM, Marketing, Ops, and Data to deliver high-impact, scalable products with measurable business impact.Embed within Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify workflow bottlenecks and lead automation and optimization initiatives.Analyze GTM funnel and conversion metrics to uncover insights and guide product priorities and roadmap decisions.Set clear goals, metrics, and success criteria for the Growth team, driving accountability to measurable outcomes.Manage and develop a team of Product Managers, fostering clarity, ownership, and a culture of high performance.Oversee core Growth Product and Engineering domains, including account scoring, TAM data, outbound automation, and GTM tooling.Align stakeholders around an aspirational 6–12 month roadmap that advances GTM efficiency and business growth.Ensure successful activation and implementation of customers initiatives by partnering with GTM and Customer Success to operationalize tooling and automations.Continuously refine activation based on feedback and performance data to drive faster time-to-value and sustainable adoption.RequirementsRelevant experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or management consulting, ideally with direct responsibility for or experience scaling B2B products and GTM systems, with a strong understanding of growth, GTM, and/or marketing pipelines.Analytical sense: You demonstrate a strong aptitude for and actively use data to inform your decision-making. Basic SQL proficiency is strongly preferred.Communication: You have proven experience working and communicating effectively with senior leaders and executives, and influencing stakeholders across departments and functions, including Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, CRMX/Business Systems, IT, Legal, and more. You excel at building trust and working relationships.Systems-thinker: You are a systems thinker, capable of thinking holistically across product, technical, and people systems to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for efficiency, automation, fraud prevention, and product growth within the payables ecosystem.CompensationThe expected salary range for this role is $340,000 - $425,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Product at Brex

The Product team is at the forefront of Brex's mission to empower employees anywhere to make better financial decisions. With a deep understanding of the business, we identify and scope out the most impactful opportunities for Brex to tackle. We are responsible for aligning cross-functional teams — such as Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Design — on key decisions. We set strategy and drive products from inception to launch, enabling Brex to grow rapidly and help our customers reach their full potential.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Leader at Brex, you will be the driving force behind our Growth Product team — overseeing the thoughtful strategy and execution of team and technical systems to drive customer acquisition and onboarding. You will also collaborate closely with our Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure seamless acquisition and onboarding for customers, particularly those with significant and complex spending needs. You will be instrumental in creating features, models, and tools that empower our GTM and Marketing teams to get maximal leverage out of their efforts. You will work closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, based in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Vancouver, Brazil, and remote locations. Past examples of work in this domain include AI agents for GTM workflows, developing best-in-class GTM data and enrichment systems, ML models for account prioritization, prospect AI classification systems, and more.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in either our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City office. You must be willing to work in the office at least 3 days per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.

Responsibilities

  • Drive product and systems investments that improve GTM metrics such as CAC payback, pipeline conversion, and efficiency.
  • Define and execute a multi-quarter Growth strategy in partnership with Engineering, Design, GTM, Marketing, Ops, and Data to deliver high-impact, scalable products with measurable business impact.
  • Embed within Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify workflow bottlenecks and lead automation and optimization initiatives.
  • Analyze GTM funnel and conversion metrics to uncover insights and guide product priorities and roadmap decisions.
  • Set clear goals, metrics, and success criteria for the Growth team, driving accountability to measurable outcomes.
  • Manage and develop a team of Product Managers, fostering clarity, ownership, and a culture of high performance.
  • Oversee core Growth Product and Engineering domains, including account scoring, TAM data, outbound automation, and GTM tooling.
  • Align stakeholders around an aspirational 6–12 month roadmap that advances GTM efficiency and business growth.
  • Ensure successful activation and implementation of customers initiatives by partnering with GTM and Customer Success to operationalize tooling and automations.
  • Continuously refine activation based on feedback and performance data to drive faster time-to-value and sustainable adoption.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or management consulting, ideally with direct responsibility for or experience scaling B2B products and GTM systems, with a strong understanding of growth, GTM, and/or marketing pipelines.
  • Analytical sense: You demonstrate a strong aptitude for and actively use data to inform your decision-making. Basic SQL proficiency is strongly preferred.
  • Communication: You have proven experience working and communicating effectively with senior leaders and executives, and influencing stakeholders across departments and functions, including Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, CRMX/Business Systems, IT, Legal, and more. You excel at building trust and working relationships.
  • Systems-thinker: You are a systems thinker, capable of thinking holistically across product, technical, and people systems to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for efficiency, automation, fraud prevention, and product growth within the payables ecosystem.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $340,000 - $425,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

descriptionHtml:
We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix. Nuix is one of the greatest comeback Technology success stories in Australia, and we're making massive waves each day. Nuix is, and will be, a pioneer in the Australian Technology space, and we're carrying the torch on what "good" looks like.

This extends to our People. We're fiercely passionate, love working at pace, thrive in ambiguity, live, and breathe outside of the box, and above all are good humans. Our impact extends outside of our 9-5, and our place in society isn't always defined by corporate metrics. We're determined to make a positive difference in the world, whether through our solutions which help the top companies, governments and agencies find the truth and combat illegal activities, or through our people who care about contributing and giving back both within, and outside, of Nuix. We are a Force For Good.

We're selective about who comes on board, and you should be too. But if the above sounds like a match, get in touch today and get ready for the possibility of starting a once-in-a-career journey.

Role Overview

Nuix Discover is a dedicated eDiscovery and legal review platform with a distinct product identity, a separate engineering team based in Pittsburgh. The Head of Product, Discover is the product owner of the entire Discover platform - responsible for the roadmap, the product strategy, and the cross-functional delivery cadence.

This is a senior product leadership role reporting directly to the EVP, Discover Business Unit. The role operates with dedicated product accountability for the Discover platform, drawing on shared services from the broader Nuix Product & Technology organisation - including engineers and product managers who sit within those structures and are allocated to Discover work. Day-to-day, you are the product owner and commercial product voice for Discover; you do not have direct line management of the engineers or PMs but are expected to lead through influence, prioritisation authority, and close partnership with the CPTO's organisation.

Location:

This role reports to the EVP, Discover Business Unit and can be based in New York, NY, Washington, DC metro area or Pennsylvania. Candidates located near our Pittsburgh, PA or Reston, VA office will have a hybrid work schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Discover product roadmap end-to-end: prioritise features and capabilities against market opportunity, customer feedback, and competitive positioning, with clear release cadence and measurable outcomes.
  • Serve as the primary product interface between the allocated Discover engineering and PM resources (shared services from the Product & Technology organisation) and the Discover commercial business - set priorities, maintain the backlog, and ensure delivery cadence aligns with commercial commitments, without direct line authority over those teams.
  • Drive a coherent product strategy for both the SaaS and on-premise variants of Discover, managing the tension between these two deployment models as the SaaS transition accelerates.
  • Define and maintain a clear competitive positioning framework against the major eDiscovery review platforms (such as Relativity, Reveal, CS Disco, Opus 2), identifying where Discover wins and where it needs to close gaps.
  • Own the voice-of-customer programme for Discover: establish structured feedback loops with law firms, corporate legal, and government users; run advisory councils and convert insight into product decisions.
  • Collaborate within the Nuix product organisation to identify where AI-assisted review, classification, and analytics capabilities create meaningful differentiation for the Discover platform specifically.
  • Define and track product-level KPIs - platform adoption, feature utilisation, NPS, time-to-value for new deployments - and use these to inform roadmap trade-offs.
  • Operate as a key stakeholder in pricing and packaging decisions for Discover, working with commercial leadership to design product tiers, usage-based models, and upgrade paths that support ACV growth

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 15+ years in product management, with at least 3 years in a senior or group product management role responsible for a complex enterprise SaaS or software platform - you have owned a roadmap, managed a cross-functional squad, and shipped consequential product.
  • Deep domain knowledge of the eDiscovery market - you understand the review workflow, the key buyer personas (lawyers, litigation support, IT), and the competitive landscape well enough to walk into a law firm and hold a credible product conversation.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a dual-mode product (SaaS and on-premise or hosted), including the sequencing and migration challenges that come with moving an existing installed base toward a cloud-first model.
  • Strong commercial instincts - experience working with sales, pricing, and commercial teams to structure packaging and features that drive ACV growth, not just feature completeness.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a shared-services or matrix model - you have owned product outcomes without owning the engineers or PMs, and you know how to maintain velocity, accountability, and quality in that structure.

Desired Expertise

  • Background as a lawyer, litigation support professional, or former user of eDiscovery platforms - genuine first-hand understanding of the review matter lifecycle is a meaningful differentiator in this role.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML-assisted review, predictive coding, or TAR (Technology Assisted Review) capabilities into a legal tech product.

Nuix is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t let imposter syndrome hold you back! We welcome all applications and are a flexible employer.

We strive to make any required adjustments where possible to make the process fair and equitable for everyone. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please note this in your job application.

Nuix is on an incredible journey of transformation, aligning our strengths with our ambitions to pursue greater opportunities. To find out more about who we are and what we are doing, please visit our web page.

https://www.nuix.com/

As we expand our global team and extend our skills and expertise, we are unified as one Nuix team guided by our shared values.

Nuix Vision

Finding Truth in a Digital World.

Nuix Mission Statement

Nuix creates innovative software that empowers organizations to simply and quickly find the truth from any data in a digital world. We are a passionate and talented team, delighting our customers with software that transforms data into actionable intelligence.

Nuix Values

  • TAKE OWNERSHIP
  • RESILIENT
  • UNAFRAID
  • TEAM NUIX
  • HERO OUR CUSTOMERS

We believe in these principles and seek to weave them into the fabric of our daily work at Nuix. In doing so, we co-create a dynamic and purposeful company culture that we can be proud of and want to belong to.

  • Nuix is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

Love the role, but not the right fit for you? Know someone that might be awesome for this role?

We're always looking for talented people who want to make a real impact. If you refer someone and we successfully hire them, you'll receive a $1,000 gift card.

Send referrals to recruitment@nuix.com or message us on LinkedIn. T's & C's apply.

To all recruitment agencies: Nuix does not accept agency CV's unless we have an existing agreement. Please do not forward CV's to us, or our Nuix employees directly. Nuix is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes, or where there is not an agreement in place.

See the bigger picture, faster.

We are a leading provider of investigative analytics and intelligence software, that empowers our customers to be a force for good by finding truth in the digital world. We help customers collect, process and review massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, making it searchable and actionable at scale and speed, and with forensic accuracy. Our users rely on Nuix software to assist with challenges as diverse as criminal investigations, data privacy, eDiscovery, regulatory compliance and insider threats.

Powered by AI.

Our solutions are powered by our patented data processing engine and enhanced with AI such as Natural Language Processing. Our AI capabilities super-charge our software to identify patterns and correlations that no human could find, so that our customers get to the most relevant or risky data faster, saving on time, cost, reputation damage and even lives.

descriptionHtml:
Lead the evolution of wealth-focused products on a global scale, shaping how investment data, technology, and services connect asset managers with distribution channels - with a particular focus on the UK IFA market.

This is a high-impact leadership role at the centre of product strategy, with a clear mandate to define and scale a market-leading wealth proposition rooted in a deep understanding of the UK wealth distribution landscape, especially IFAs. You will work closely with senior leadership to shape strategy, drive innovation, and ensure our offering is tightly aligned to the needs of this critical segment.

With exposure to global clients, regulatory developments, and potential M&A opportunities, this role offers both strategic depth and commercial impact, making it an exciting opportunity for an experienced product leader with strong domain expertise in UK wealth.

Your key responsibilities as a Head of UK Wealth Products will include:

  • Defining and owning the product vision and roadmap for wealth-focused offerings, with a strong emphasis on the UK IFA and wealth management market
  • Leading the full product lifecycle from ideation through to launch and optimisation, ensuring solutions meet the specific needs of IFAs and related distribution channels
  • Acting as a subject matter expert on UK wealth distribution, bringing deep insight into IFA behaviours, platforms, and market dynamics
  • Driving market analysis, client engagement, and thought leadership to shape innovative and competitive product solutions
  • Collaborating with Commercial, Engineering, Client Experience, and other teams to deliver high-quality, scalable products
  • Managing strategic partnerships, including integration of third-party solutions and commercial negotiations
  • Leading and developing a globally distributed team, including resource planning, budget ownership, and performance management


You will need the following experience and skills to join us as a Head of UK Wealth Products:

  • You will bring extensive product management or product strategy experience within the fund or investment management industry
  • You will have deep, demonstrable knowledge of the UK wealth distribution market, particularly the IFA landscape, platforms, and client needs
  • You will have a strong understanding of how IFAs interact with data, technology, and investment solutions, and how this translates into product opportunities
  • You will demonstrate the ability to translate complex market dynamics and client requirements into clear, actionable product strategies
  • You will have proven experience influencing senior stakeholders and leading cross-functional teams in a global environment
  • You will possess strong commercial acumen, with experience driving product growth, partnerships, and business outcomes


FE fundinfo is a leading financial data provider, connecting the investment industry across the UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific through an integrated platform. Our skilled team empowers clients with data-driven insights, making the industry Navigate Complexity with Confidence!

You will be part of a collaborative, international environment where innovation, ownership, and strategic thinking are highly valued. Based in London with a hybrid working approach, you will work closely with global teams across product, technology, and commercial functions. The organisation supports continuous learning, encourages new ideas, and provides the platform to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced and evolving industry.

Benefits

  • UK 25 days of annual leave with the option to buy an extra 5 days each year.
  • Benefit from enhanced paternity, maternity, and shared parental leave.
  • Secure your future with our pension scheme.
  • Advance your career with sponsored learning and development, including formal qualifications.
  • Private medical insurance as employee wellbeing matters
  • Stay fit with discounted gym memberships.
  • Take advantage of the Bike to Work scheme for eco-friendly commuting.

Apply now and we'll aim to get back to you with feedback within 5 working days.

descriptionHtml:
About Lebull.pt


Lebull.pt is a licensed and regulated sportsbook and casino operator in Portugal. We are passionate about delivering an exciting, safe, and responsible online gaming experience.


Role Purpose:


Own the end-to-end player experience across app and web, driving improvements in conversion, engagement, and retention. Ensure Lebull's product (iOS, Android, web) becomes a competitive advantage by translating growth insights into product improvements that increase LTV and marketing efficiency.


Core Responsibilities:


Product Ownership:



  • Own Lebull's app (iOS & Android) and website experience;

  • Define and manage the product roadmap aligned with business and growth priorities;

  • Prioritise features based on impact on conversion, retention, and engagement;

  • Ensure product features comply with regulatory requirements and responsible gaming standards.


Funnel & Conversion Optimisation:



  • Improve key conversion steps: registration, KYC, first deposit;

  • Identify friction points and lead initiatives to improve user journey performance;

  • Work closely with Marketing to translate data into product improvements.


Retention & Engagement:



  • Define and improve retention mechanics (gamification, user journeys, in-app engagement);

  • Collaborate with Promo and CRM teams on feature-driven retention strategies;

  • Increase user frequency and long-term value (LTV).


Product Strategy & Roadmap:



  • Define product priorities based on user data, competitive benchmarking, and market trends;

  • Ensure Lebull remains competitive vs leading operators in Portugal.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:



  • Work closely with Growth, Brand, Tech, and Country Manager;

  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements.


Delivery & Execution:



  • Own product backlog and prioritisation;

  • Work with tech teams and project managers to ensure timely delivery;

  • Ensure features are delivered with clear success metrics.


Key KPIs:



  • Conversion rates (registration → deposit);

  • App performance (install → activation → deposit);

  • Retention and churn;

  • User engagement (frequency, session depth);

  • Contribution to LTV improvement.


Ideal Profile:



  • Experience in product management, growth product, or UX-driven roles;

  • Strong understanding of conversion funnels and user behaviour;

  • Data-driven, comfortable with analytics and A/B testing;

  • Experience with mobile apps and web platforms;

  • Ability to translate business goals into product features;

  • Experience in betting, gaming, fintech, or high-conversion consumer apps is a plus.


What This Role Is Not:



  • Not a project manager;

  • Not a technical lead;

  • Not purely UX or design.
