Director of Product

Bloom Nutrition

IG @Bloomsupps @Marillewellyn

TikTok @Bloomnu

Bloomnu.com


About Bloom

Founded by wellness influencer and entrepreneur Mari Llewellyn, Bloom Nutrition is one of the fastest growing wellness brands in the U.S. Our mission is to help people bloom into their best selves through nutritious and delicious wellness solutions.

Recognized for our innovation and growth, we’re proud recipients of several awards:

🏆 Forbes 30 Under 30 (2023)

🏆 Target Partner of the Year (2023)

🏆 LinkedIn’s Top Start-Ups (2023 & 2024)

🏆 EY Entrepreneurs of the Year (2024)

🏆 Inc. 5000 Company (2024 & 2025)

🏆 NewBeauty 100 Wellness Awards (2024)


Reports To: SVP of Brand


Location: Austin, TX (Mon-Thurs onsite)


Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic and consumer-obsessed Director of Product to lead the creation of bold, craveable beverages - flavors and products - from concept to rollout. This role sits at the intersection of consumer insights, product storytelling, and brand strategy, ensuring every product delivers both exceptional taste and strong consumer relevance.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of consumer trends, market opportunities, and product development. This role will partner cross-functionally to create products and flavors that resonate with consumers and fuel business growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify emerging flavor trends, ingredient innovations, and whitespace opportunities
  • Translate consumer insights, retailer needs, and business objectives into compelling product concepts
  • Create and maintain a multi-year innovation & flavor roadmap aligned with company goals
  • Develop detailed product briefs that capture flavor direction, consumer target, positioning, and key product attributes to align internal teams and external partners
  • Partner with R&D team and flavor houses to develop differentiated flavor profiles and manage timelines
  • Guide flavor exploration, evaluation, and optimization through structured tasting sessions and consumer feedback
  • Support formulation refinements and product optimization
  • Ensure product concepts, messaging, and design elements effectively communicate consumer benefits and brand values
  • Own product development timelines and key milestones, ensuring cross-functional teams - including creative, project management, stay on track from concept approval through final art files
  • Partner with the creative and project management teams to ensure all packaging assets and can art files are completed accurately and on time
  • Drive alignment across stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in beverage innovation, product development, brand innovation, or related CPG categories
  • Demonstrated success developing and launching beverage products from concept to market
  • Strong understanding of flavor development, formulation processes, and beverage industry trends
  • Experience working directly with flavor houses, ingredient suppliers, and external development partners
  • Deep expertise in consumer insights, trend analysis, and innovation strategy
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally across marketing, creative, commercial, and technical teams
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong analytical thinking combined with creative problem-solving capabilities
  • Bachelor's degree in related field


Benefits:

  • Fun and inclusive work environment with a super collaborative team
  • Access to Company Insurance (Health, Dental, Vision)
  • Company-wide events
  • 401(k) plan that the company matches because your future should bloom as well
  • Generous PTO because work-life balance is important
  • A brand new company laptop (yes, it’s Apple)
  • Access to all the Bloom supplements and swag so you can bloom into your best self!


Bloom is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.


This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with it. The company reserves the right to modify the duties or assign additional duties as necessary.

Head of Product – Incident Management (Remote)


We’re hiring a Head of Product to lead mission-critical incident management tools used by fire agencies and emergency operations teams during active wildfire and extreme-weather events.

This role is for a product leader with real incident management experience.


You’ll own product strategy and execution for situational awareness and incident response tools that bring real-time weather, fire behavior, and operational intelligence directly to incident commanders, dispatchers, and EOCs.


What you’ll do

  • Lead product strategy and roadmap for incident management and situational awareness products
  • Turn complex weather, fire, and geospatial data into clear, actionable insights for responders
  • Partner closely with engineering, science, and customer domain experts
  • Work directly with fire agencies and incident management teams to shape real-world workflows
  • Manage and mentor a small team of Product Managers


What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years in product management, including leadership experience
  • Direct experience with incident management, emergency response, or wildfire operations
  • Strong understanding of CAD systems and ICS/NIMS workflows
  • Experience building real-time, mission-critical software for operational users

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Product Management - Developer Experience based in the United States.

This leadership role sits at the center of a company-wide transformation in how software is built, shipped, and scaled. You will own the vision and execution of the developer experience platform, shaping the tools, workflows, and AI-enabled systems that empower engineers and increasingly non-engineering builders across the organization. The scope spans the entire software development lifecycle, including local development environments, CI/CD, observability, internal platforms, and agentic AI-driven workflows. You will lead a team of product managers while partnering closely with engineering, security, and AI platform leaders to deliver a unified, paved-path developer ecosystem. A core part of the role is defining how AI fundamentally reshapes development speed, quality, and accessibility. This is a highly strategic, high-impact position where your work directly influences engineering productivity and the pace of innovation across the company.

Accountabilities

  • Define and lead the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for the developer experience ecosystem, spanning inner dev loop tooling, CI/CD, observability, internal developer platforms, and AI-driven development workflows.
  • Lead and develop a team of product managers, each responsible for key areas of the DevEx portfolio, ensuring strong execution, prioritization, and alignment with engineering leadership.
  • Drive the company’s AI-for-development strategy, including evaluation, governance, rollout, and measurement of AI coding assistants and agentic software development tools.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to co-own platform outcomes, shared OKRs, and adoption of paved-path development practices across all product teams.
  • Define and track DevEx success metrics such as developer productivity, cycle time, deployment reliability, adoption rates, and AI leverage across engineering workflows.
  • Translate developer pain points into prioritized, data-driven product bets through deep discovery with engineers, staff/principal engineers, EMs, and adjacent business stakeholders.
  • Lead adoption strategy ensuring internal teams consistently choose standardized platforms and workflows that improve speed, quality, and scalability of software delivery.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including significant leadership of developer-facing, infrastructure, or platform products in complex technical environments.
  • Proven experience leading multi-team, multi-year product roadmaps at a Director level, with a strong track record of delivering widely adopted internal platforms.
  • Strong technical fluency with software engineering concepts, SDLC tooling, cloud platforms, and modern AI-assisted or agentic development approaches.
  • Hands-on technical background in engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or ML/AI engineering earlier in career, enabling credibility with senior engineering stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of product metrics for developer productivity (e.g., DORA, SPACE) and ability to build measurement frameworks beyond vanity metrics.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product management teams.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence VP-level and executive audiences through clear, outcome-driven storytelling.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary with equity awards tied to performance and impact
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Flexible remote work across the United States
  • Paid time off, holidays, and parental leave programs
  • Professional development and continuous learning opportunities in AI and platform engineering
  • Inclusive, high-performance culture focused on innovation and engineering excellence
  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI-native development tools and agentic workflows
  • Opportunity to shape developer experience at enterprise scale with high organizational visibility

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many bill payers as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

Why Flex needs YOU

We’re hiring a Director of Product for AI & Agentic Customer Support to own the strategy and outcomes for how Flex resolves customer issues - automatically, intelligently, and at scale. Customer support at Flex is a multi-channel operation spanning AI voice, AI chat, live chat, email, and live human voice, serving bill payers managing payments, billing changes, onboarding and identity, account issues, and more. With hundreds of human agents and a rapidly growing bill payment base, the mission is to resolve more, faster, and with less friction.

This role owns the full agentic stack: the in-app customer experience that routes bill payers to the right channel and drives toward self-resolution; the LLM-native orchestration layer that powers automated resolution; the ML-driven intelligence for routing, personalization, and issue prediction; and the capability primitives that make human agents dramatically more effective. You will set the strategy, define the architecture, and be accountable for the outcomes — automation rates, customer resolution rates, first contact resolution, and average handle time.

This is a 0-to-1 role. The agentic architecture is being defined now, and you will define it with us. This role is ideal for someone who has built agentic or AI-driven systems in data-rich environments, knows how to write PRDs/specs that ML engineers (and their agents) trust, and has the judgment to choose LLM-native orchestration when it’s warranted and deterministic automation when it’s not.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy and outcomes for all things agentic. Set the multi-quarter roadmap for automated resolution, intelligent routing, and agent augmentation. Define and own the key metrics — customer resolution rate, automation rate, first contact resolution, and average handle time reduction for human agents — and drive the product decisions that move them.
  • Design the in-app customer support experience. Own how bill payers discover, access, and navigate support inside the Flex app. This includes intelligent channel routing — directing customers to the right channel (AI chat, voice, human escalation) based on issue type, history, and predicted resolution likelihood — as well as the in-app AI-driven interaction experience itself. The goal is maximum self-resolution before a human agent is ever needed.
  • Build the agentic resolution platform. Design the LLM-native orchestration layer for fully automated CS resolution — tool-calling agents, multi-step workflows, context-aware decision trees, and graceful fallback routing to human queues. Define what actions agents can take (payment retries, balance corrections, account updates), what guardrails govern them, and how confidence thresholds drive escalation.
  • Own the customer intelligence layer. Write PRDs for the ML-driven capabilities that power personalization, intent classification, dynamic routing, and proactive issue detection. Define the customer context model — what signals matter, how they are assembled, and how they are served in real time to both automated and human-facing systems.
  • Drive the interaction data model. Work with the data platform team to establish the interaction ledger, event schema, and feedback loops that make sustained intelligence improvements possible at scale.
  • Define the vendor integration product layer. Own requirements for how Flex’s AI voice and chat vendors integrate into the orchestration architecture — API contracts, context payloads, handoff protocols, and performance standards. You are not selecting vendors; you are ensuring the vendor layer is a composable component, not a constraint on what the agentic system can do.
  • Enable AI assist for human agents. Partner with the CS product PM who owns the agent-facing UX to define the underlying capability primitives: suggested responses, real-time context surfacing, post-contact summarization, and escalation briefing. You own the intelligence layer; they own how agents experience it.
  • Set the architecture direction. Author the decision records and strategy memos that inform multi-quarter investment across engineering, ML, and data platforms. Represent the AI & Agentic roadmap to Platform and CS leadership.

Key Qualifications

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years working directly on AI, ML, or agentic systems in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated 0-to-1 track record: you have taken an AI-powered capability from concept through launch in an ambiguous, resource-constrained environment.
  • Experience owning end-to-end customer-facing AI experiences, including how users are routed, how AI-driven interactions are designed, and how resolution quality is measured and improved.
  • Ability to write PRDs for ML systems - feature engineering specs, model evaluation criteria, training data requirements, latency and accuracy tradeoffs. You do not need to write the code; you need to write documents that ML engineers trust.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-native orchestration: tool-calling, multi-step agents, prompt engineering in production contexts, context and memory management.
  • Strong judgment on when to use LLM reasoning vs. deterministic rules - and the intellectual honesty to apply that judgment even when LLM is the more compelling answer.
  • Comfort owning outcomes, not just output. You track the metrics that matter - resolution rates, automation rates, handle time - and treat them as your own, not your engineering team’s.
  • Excellent written communication. At Flex, the PRD is the primary artifact of product leadership. Yours should reduce ambiguity, not create it.
  • Bonus: Experience in fintech, payments, or any domain where automated actions carry financial or compliance risk. Prior exposure to contact center platforms, AI voice or chat vendors, or CRM integration patterns.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) and Tier 3 (Salt Lake City) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. If you are located outside of the cities listed below, your starting pay will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. Please speak with your recruiter for additional information regarding the specific range for your location.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area)

$248,000—$310,000 USD

Tier 3 (Salt Lake City)

  • Define and lead the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for the developer experience ecosystem, spanning inner dev loop tooling, CI/CD, observability, internal developer platforms, and AI-driven development workflows.

  • Drive the company’s AI-for-development strategy, including evaluation, governance, rollout, and measurement of AI coding assistants and agentic software development tools.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to co-own platform outcomes, shared OKRs, and adoption of paved-path development practices across all product teams.
  • Define and track DevEx success metrics such as developer productivity, cycle time, deployment reliability, adoption rates, and AI leverage across engineering workflows.

  • Lead adoption strategy ensuring internal teams consistently choose standardized platforms and workflows that improve speed, quality, and scalability of software delivery.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including significant leadership of developer-facing, infrastructure, or platform products in complex technical environments.
  • Proven experience leading multi-team, multi-year product roadmaps at a Director level, with a strong track record of delivering widely adopted internal platforms.
  • Strong technical fluency with software engineering concepts, SDLC tooling, cloud platforms, and modern AI-assisted or agentic development approaches.
  • Hands-on technical background in engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or ML/AI engineering earlier in career, enabling credibility with senior engineering stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of product metrics for developer productivity (e.g., DORA, SPACE) and ability to build measurement frameworks beyond vanity metrics.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing product management teams.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence VP-level and executive audiences through clear, outcome-driven storytelling.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary with equity awards tied to performance and impact
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Flexible remote work across the United States
  • Paid time off, holidays, and parental leave programs
  • Professional development and continuous learning opportunities in AI and platform engineering
  • Inclusive, high-performance culture focused on innovation and engineering excellence
  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI-native development tools and agentic workflows
  • Opportunity to shape developer experience at enterprise scale with high organizational visibility

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Description

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

Qcells Service Solutions(‘QSS’) is a residential solar asset operation and maintenance service company powered by Qcells. QSS set up a design standard and installation guide for EnFin TPO and provide a specialized Quality assurance review service. QSS monitors all assets proactively to resolve any issue, so that maximizes homeowner experience and capital investor’s value.

The QSS Director of Product and Platform develops and leads the digital systems, tools, and operational processes that ensure consistent quality, reliability, and efficiency across the company’s residential solar TPO asset portfolio. This role bridges technology and operations — integrating data platforms, field workflows, and automation to enhance the customer experience, maximize asset up time, and ensure long-term performance of residential solar and storage systems owned under TPO structures.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in product strategy, operational technology, and asset lifecycle management, with deep understanding of residential solar operations, installer ecosystems, and post-installation service models.

The Director oversees Product and Platform teams, manages the strategic roadmap for all QA/QC and O&M digital platforms supporting residential solar TPO assets. This role focuses on automation and standardization to support rapid volume growth and consistent quality across installers and markets.

The Director also collaborates with internal subject matter experts to identify requirements and propose new products and platforms to leadership. This role should manage the project timeline and deliver clear benefits to business owners.

Third-Party Ownership (TPO) continues to be one of the fastest-growing segments in the solar industry, fueled by rising interest rates and the Inflation Reduction Act. Qcells is strategically positioned to capitalize on this trend through its domestic content tax credit advantages, strong dealer network, and advanced point-of-sale financing platform.

This position reports to the Head of the QSS Team or other personnel designated by the President of the Company.

Responsibilities

  • Own the strategic roadmap for all QA/QC and O&M digital platforms supporting residential solar TPO assets.
  • Lead design, development, and optimization of systems for inspection management, issue resolution, ticket tracking, and field performance visibility.
  • Partner with software vendors and internal engineering/data teams to build scalable tools for asset lifecycle management — from commissioning to service closure.
  • Integrate QA/QC and O&M platforms with enterprise systems (e.g., Salesforce, Aurora, internal platform and 3rd party monitoring tools).
  • Drive automation and process standardization to support rapid volume growth and consistent quality across installers and markets.
  • Oversee digital inspection workflows for system commissioning, post-install audits, and field quality validation
  • Lead design and continuous improvement of platforms for preventive maintenance, corrective work orders, warranty management, and customer service coordination.
  • Build KPI dashboards to track fleet uptime, issue resolution times, and warranty recovery performance.
  • Integrate O&M ticketing systems with inverter monitoring data and CRM tools for automated alerts and root-cause analysis.
  • Support O&M vendor enablement and ensure standardized reporting and documentation from third-party service providers.
  • Develop and enforce data governance standards for asset health, QA/QC, and O&M workflows.
  • Consolidate multiple data sources (monitoring, CRM, ticketing, inspection data) into a single visibility layer for business intelligence and reporting.
  • Deliver executive dashboards summarizing asset quality and operational health
  • Drive platform adoption, user training, and performance optimization across internal teams and installer partners.
  • Establish SOPs for platform-driven quality and O&M processes, ensuring consistency and compliance across markets.
  • Evaluate new tools, technologies, and integrations to support evolving TPO portfolio requirements.
  • Implement automation and AI-based solutions to reduce manual review time and improve response velocity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, renewable energy, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 7-10 years of experience in solar, renewable energy, or energy services, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Strong background in product, platform, or digital operations
  • Deep understanding of TPO structures, asset lifecycle management, and customer-facing solar operations.
  • Expertise in product management, data integration, and operational software development
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, PowerBI/Tableau, or similar platforms
  • Proven experience managing large service teams and third-party vendors.
  • Comprehensive technical knowledge of solar PV systems, energy storage, and monitoring platforms.
  • Excellent leadership, customer engagement, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated data-driven decision-making with experience in KPI development, tracking, and reporting.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and reporting.
  • Ability to identify and develop key strategic partnerships that enhance operational and business performance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, and executive presence.
  • Comfortable engaging with external stakeholders, including executives and partners, and skilled in delivering presentations, negotiations, and contract reviews.
  • Self-motivated, creative, and skilled in strategic planning and execution.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the TPO industry

Hanwha Q CELLS America Inc. (“HQCA”) is a Qcells company, one of the world’s largest manufacturers and providers of solar photovoltaic (PV) products and solutions. Headquartered in Irvine, California, HQCA has been rapidly expanding its business in North America through the expansion of products and solutions, including distributed energy solutions, direct-to-homeowner solar sales and financing, and EPC services. We provide an opportunity to be part of an exciting and growing world-class global business in an interesting and expanding industry of the future.

These are requirements normally expected to perform regular job duties. Incumbent must be able to successfully perform all of the functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Position Summary

The Sr. Manager of Research & Development is responsible for managing the Research & Development (R&D) teams to execute science-driven innovation and formulation strategies for food, chocolates, cosmetics, and nutritional supplement products. Helps develop and optimize products to meet consumer needs, regulatory requirements, and market differentiation. Continuously evaluates the product portfolio and suggests improvements based on experience, trends and customer feedback. Ensures all projects align with company strategy, timelines and technical standards.

Requirements

MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Biochemistry, or Cosmetic Science or related field with 7+ years of industry-related experience; or a Master's degree with 5+ years of experience; or a PhD with 3+ years of relevant industry experience (PhD is preferred)
  • A minimum of 3 years of leadership experience managing R&D, formulation, or scientific teams within the nutraceutical, functional food, chocolates, and/or personal care industries is required
  • Strong track record of successfully leading and managing research and product development teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex scientific concepts for various audiences.
  • Experience with research evaluation, literature review, ingredient assessment, and claims substantiation to support innovative product development and commercialization
  • Demonstrated examples of dietary supplements, functional foods, and wellness-focused personal care products, with a strong understanding of formulation science, ingredient functionality, and regulatory requirements
  • Hands-on formulation and manufacturing experience with nutrition and protein bars, chocolate products, and functional snack applications utilizing food technology, and ingredients such as proteins, nuts, fibers, and natural sweeteners
  • Knowledge of product development processes for cosmetics and personal care products, including ingredient compatibility, stability, and consumer-driven innovation
  • Strong understanding of FDA, FTC, DSHEA, labeling regulations, and product claims compliance across dietary supplements, food products, and personal care categories
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Operations, Quality, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to successfully scale products from concept through commercialization.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and demonstrate the ability to organize and prioritize multiple competing tasks and demands

Other Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Lead R&D innovation and formulation initiatives across dietary supplements, functional foods, protein bars, chocolate products, and wellness-focused personal care products.
  • Evaluate ingredients, technologies, delivery systems, and dosage forms (capsules, powders, liquids, bars, and others) using scientific evidence to substantiate product efficacy and health claim substantiation
  • Manage product development team, and help guide projects from concept through commercialization, including formulation, prototyping, pilot production, scale-up, validation, and manufacturing transfer.
  • Integrate inventory-driven formulations to deplete excess inventories of discontinued formulas, blended powders and raw materials
  • Develop and formulate new meal replacement and nutrition bars, food products, and chocolates
  • Resolve any issues related to raw materials, formulations, and processes. Assist in pilot batches, scale-up activities, technical validation, and troubleshooting during manufacturing
  • Help guide raw material storage strategies in conjunction with Planning, Purchasing, and Inventory teams
  • Communicate and share emerging science and technologies, along with project status, risks, and recommendations, to senior leadership and the CEO.
  • Organizational skills in managing multiple projects, timelines, and stakeholder expectations
  • Implement R&D best practices, including PD lab operations, documentation standards, experimental design, and process optimization for scalable manufacturing
  • Set long-term R&D and innovation roadmap aligned with business growth and senior leadership
  • Cultivate external partnerships with suppliers, research institutions, and associations.
  • Critically evaluate published clinical research, technical reports, and related literature
  • Monitor market trends, competitor products, and emerging science
  • Understand label copy and promotional material workflows, ensuring proper review and approvals are completed
  • Represent the company at trade shows and meet with external clients/vendors, as needed
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities, as assigned

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Duties are performed primarily in a smoke-free laboratory and office environment
  • We pride ourselves on maintaining a clean and organized environment, fostering a sense of pride and ownership in our space
  • Our culture is rich in diversity, quality, safety, fun, and respect, creating a vibrant and inclusive atmosphere
  • We are dedicated to professionalism and growth, continually striving to improve and excel in all we do

Physical Requirements

  • Frequent sitting
  • Able to lift up to 25 lbs

Benefits

ProCaps provides :

  • A competitive salary!
  • Top-Tier Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage - $0 when you qualify for the Wellness Program!
  • Paid Time Off, Eight (8) Company Holidays
  • 401(k) with Company Match - up to 4.5%
  • 100% Company Life Coverage
  • 100% Short Term Disability Coverage
  • Gym Membership Reimbursement
  • Vitamin Allowance + Discounts
  • Company-Funded Health Savings Account ($1,600/year)
  • Cash Reward Employee Referral Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • Fantastic work environment that focuses on Safety, Quality, Community, and amazing people. We hire top talent and celebrate the ingenuity and tenacity of our team members and leaders!

About the Opportunity: 

Seekr is building the AI platform that enterprises and government agencies trust for mission-critical decisions. As our technology organization scales, we need someone to be the operational backbone that keeps it all moving. We’re hiring a Head of Product Operations to work closely with technology leadership to bring structure, visibility, and momentum to the team.

This role is the connective tissue between product, engineering, design, research, and go-to-market. You will own cross-team project tracking, release planning, roadmap coordination, and executive reporting, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and leadership always has a clear picture of where things stand. This starts as an individual contributor role with genuine leadership trajectory: as the team grows, you’ll build and lead the Product Management Office for the technology organization.

What You'll Own:

  • Cross-team project tracking & delivery: Own visibility into project status, dependencies, risks, and timelines across the product and engineering organization. Identify blockers early and drive resolution before they become delays.
  • Release planning & roadmap coordination: Partner with PMs, Engineering leads, and Design to coordinate release cycles, align cross-functional dependencies, and ensure roadmap commitments are tracked and communicated consistently.
  • Executive & stakeholder reporting: Build and maintain the business rhythm for the product org: weekly status updates, OKR tracking, board-ready reporting, and customer-facing roadmap communications. Make complex program status clear and actionable for leadership.
  • PMO establishment & leadership: Define and implement the operating model, processes, and tooling for the product organization’s program management function. As the team scales, you will build and lead a PMO team to support the broader tech org.
  • Operational infrastructure: Establish and maintain the tools, templates, and workflows that enable PMs, Engineering leads, and Design to operate efficiently and consistently, from sprint planning rhythms to roadmap tooling to intake processes.
  • Cross-functional alignment: Facilitate alignment across product, engineering, design, research, sales, and customer success, ensuring teams are moving in the same direction and that commitments made externally are grounded in internal reality.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in product operations, program management, technical project management, or a chief of staff role within a technology organization
  • Demonstrated ability to build and run program management functions at scale in fast-moving product organizations, including cross-team tracking, release coordination, and executive reporting
  • Experience working closely with product and engineering leadership; comfortable engaging in technical conversations without being an engineer
  • Proven track record owning complex, multi-workstream programs with ambiguous scope and shifting priorities
  • Strong systems thinker: able to design operational processes, reporting structures, and tooling that scale without adding unnecessary overhead
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to synthesize complex program status into crisp, actionable narratives for executive and board audiences
  • High emotional intelligence and strong stakeholder management skills; able to hold teams accountable and drive alignment without direct authority
  • Experience in AI/ML, enterprise SaaS, or high-growth technology companies
  • Reside in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX; able to work in office on a hybrid schedule

What We’re Looking For

  • You are energized by bringing order to complexity: you see a fast-moving org and immediately start mapping what needs structure, what needs visibility, and what needs someone to own it.
  • You are a trusted operator: people loop you in early because you make things easier, not harder.
  • You are comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from detailed project tracking to preparing board-level materials, without losing quality at either end.
  • You communicate with clarity and economy: status updates, reports, and documents from you are concise, accurate, and immediately useful.
  • You have leadership ambition: you want to build a team and a function, not just maintain one.
  • You’re technically fluent enough to earn credibility in a room full of engineers and PMs, even if your background is in operations rather than engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building a PMO from scratch in a scaling technology organization
  • Background in AI/ML platform companies or adjacent technology sectors (data infrastructure, developer tools, enterprise software)
  • Familiarity with product management tooling and methodology (Jira, Linear, Productboard, or similar)
  • Experience supporting or working alongside a CPO, CTO, or VP of Product in a chief of staff or operations capacity
  • Exposure to government or defense technology programs where reporting cadence, compliance, and stakeholder communication are especially demanding
  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program management certification (a plus, not a requirement)

About the Company:

Seekr is a leader in explainable and trustworthy artificial intelligence designed to power mission-critical decisions in enterprises, government, and regulated industries. descriptionHtml:
DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT STRATEGY


Dialight is the world leader in LED industrial lighting technology with millions of LED fixtures installed worldwide. We see a world where heavy industry is transformed to be safer, more productive, and environmentally friendly through illumination. We enable industrial customers operating in demanding environments to reduce their energy costs, maintenance costs, and carbon footprint while maximizing the safety and productivity of their facilities.


Position Summary

Dialight is seeking a Director of Product Strategy to define the long-term vision, market positioning, and growth strategy for its product portfolio. This senior leader will align product roadmaps with business objectives and partners across sales, marketing, and engineering to drive commercial success. This role requires strong expertise in B2B marketing within industrial or technical markets, particularly in long sales-cycle environments and value-based selling. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with sales, product, and executive leadership to position Dialight’s solutions effectively and differentiate them in the market.


Job Responsibilities


Strategic Vision

  • Develop a cohesive, multi-year product strategy that translates market dynamics, customer needs, and business priorities into actionable investment decisions and product roadmaps.


Voice of the Customer (VoC) & Future Forecasting

  • Provide a 360 degree-view of market trends, customer behavior, and competitors’ activities, including variations between global regions (North America/ EMEA and Asia).
  • Identify opportunities for our continuous differentiation in the market – this includes products and services
  • Translate deep customer listening into actionable inputs for the engineering and R&D teams
  • Develop return on investment models for new product lines including future demand forecasting, product introduction timing and risk analysis.


Product Pitch or Value Proposition Storyline

  • Develop ‘Feature Roadmap’ for our next generation technology and product development – ‘Innovation for Purpose’ to deliver sustained customer driven growth.
  • Develop ‘Value Proposition Storyline’ for different markets (existing or new) around our products and services (existing or new).
  • Identify how the value proposition needs to regionalize to maximize growth across all global markets.


Go-To-Market (GTM) Alignment

  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product Marketing teams to define positioning, pricing models, and launch strategies.
  • Define and communicate value propositions for industrial LED lighting products
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis


Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a central connector between engineering, design, legal, and commercial teams to align on product direction, resource allocation, and timelines.


Channel & Partner Marketing

  • Support distributor and channel partner marketing initiatives
  • Develop co-marketing programs and sales enablement tools
  • Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to monitor product success and financial viability.


Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product management, product strategy, or corporate strategy
  • A Bachelor's degree is required; an MBA or advanced technical degree is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to model financials, manage product P&L, and make data-driven decisions. Exceptional executive presence and the ability to present complex strategies clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders.

descriptionHtml:
OneSparQ is looking for a Product Line Director – CBRN/CBRNe Systems for a military and defense company. This is a fully remote role with domestic and international travel.

This person will own the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of CBRN/CBRNe product lines, with a strong emphasis on CBRN filtration systems. The ideal candidate has deep technical and market knowledge of CBRN/CBRNe solutions used in military, defense, expeditionary, shelter, vehicle, or life-support applications. Experience across multiple CBRN areas, including filtration, detection, and decontamination, is highly preferred.


Required Skills:

  • 6+ years of experience with CBRN/CBRNe products, systems, or applications
  • Direct experience with CBRN filtration systems, collective protection, air handling, NBC filtration, or related life-support products
  • Strong understanding of military/defense customer requirements and product compliance expectations
  • Ability to act as a technical product expert for customers, engineering, sales, and leadership
  • Understanding of manufacturing principles and product development processes
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • US Citizen


Additional Skills: (not required)

  • Experience with CBRN detection and/or decontamination systems
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD, military shelters, expeditionary systems, defense equipment, or ruggedized products
  • Background in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • Experience supporting product roadmaps, market strategy, competitive analysis, and new product development
  • Experience working with domestic and international defense customers


Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for CBRN/CBRNe product lines
  • Serve as the company’s subject matter expert for CBRN filtration products and related defense applications
  • Identify new customers, markets, product opportunities, and business growth areas
  • Partner with engineering to guide new product development and product improvements
  • Ensure products remain competitive, compliant, manufacturable, and aligned with customer needs
  • Support sales and business development with technical product expertise
  • Analyze market trends, customer feedback, and competitor offerings to shape future product direction
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, sales, and marketing to launch and support products successfully

Symmetrio is  seeking a strategic and highly collaborative Senior Product Lead to support our client, a healthcare SaaS company focused on oncology care, to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of  their SaaS platform roadmap and end-to-end user experience initiatives. This leadership role will drive product innovation, platform enhancements, UX strategy, and cross-functional product execution across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong product leadership, customer-centric thinking, UX expertise, and operational excellence with the ability to lead high-performing teams in a fast-paced healthcare SaaS environment.

This is a full-time office-based position located in the Denver Metro area with a salary range between $180,000 and $220,000.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, own, and evolve the company's Product Management and User Experience roadmap, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities.
  • Drive product innovation, next-generation platform enhancements, scalability initiatives, and long-term capacity planning.
  • Develop and execute UX and product design strategies across the full client and contributor journey.
  • Build, lead, and develop high-performing Product Management and UX teams through coaching, mentorship, and talent development.
  • Establish and continuously improve scalable product development processes, ensuring effective prioritization, execution, and incorporation of customer feedback into the product roadmap.
  • Partner with executive leadership and key stakeholders to shape product vision, drive strategic initiatives, and ensure organizational alignment.
  • Partner with Engineering, Marketing, Brand, and Client Services teams to ensure a seamless and consistent user experience across all touchpoints.
  • Lead compliance, regulatory, and enhancement initiatives while proactively communicating organizational impact and requirements to leadership.
  • Champion Agile, Lean Product Development, and modern UX best practices throughout the organization.
  • Utilize A/B testing, analytics, and customer insights to optimize user engagement, acquisition, and retention.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies, and strategic partnership opportunities to inform product strategy.
  • Lead product design sessions, define platform capabilities, and document functional requirements and feature enhancements.
  • Oversee product release planning, prioritization, estimation, and execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Brief and train Sales and Client Services teams on product capabilities, enhancements, and positioning.
  • Act as a collaborative leader across the organization and contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Must be based in the Denver Metro area or willing to relocate.
  • 7+ years of progressive Product Management experience within SaaS or technology-driven environments.
  • Proven success leading Product Management and UX/UI initiatives in complex, fast-paced organizations.
  • Strong experience developing and executing product strategy, roadmaps, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Experience gathering and prioritizing requirements
  • Deep understanding of UX principles, customer journey mapping, and human-centered design methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile, Scrum, Lean Product Development, and iterative product delivery models.
  • Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO) certification required.
  • Demonstrated success managing cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Client Services.
  • Experience leveraging analytics, customer insights, and A/B testing to drive product optimization and user engagement.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive alignment across teams.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or regulated SaaS environments preferred.

Benefits

  • Base salary range: $180,000 - $220,000 annually
  • Annual bonus opportunity based on company performance and individual contribution
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Collaborative and entrepreneurial work environment
  • High visibility and meaningful impact across the organization
  • Career growth and leadership opportunities

descriptionHtml:
About The Company

Wadhwani AI Global (WAIG) is a non-profit AI research and product organisation building AI for social impact across the Global South, outside India. We work with governments, multilateral institutions, foundations, and on-the-ground partners to deploy AI solutions in agriculture, health, and education at population scale. With deepening operations in Rwanda, Kenya, Ethiopia, and across the African continent, we are entering a new phase of growth — building product capability that matches the scale and ambition of our partnerships.

Requirements

Role Overview

The Head of Product will lead products across the organisation. This is a senior leadership role responsible for the AI products WAIG builds, deploys, and scales across health, education, agriculture, and other social impact verticals. This role owns the product function end-to-end and partners closely with leadership on strategy, delivery, and donor engagement.

Your Role

  • Product Strategy & Vision
  • Define the product vision, roadmap, and priorities across health, education, and agriculture verticals
  • Translate WAIG's mission and donor commitments into a coherent multi-year product strategy
  • Make build-vs-partner-vs-consume decisions for AI capabilities across the portfolio
  • Drive product positioning in donor conversations, government engagements, and partner discussions
  • Delivery & Execution
  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI products from concept through deployment and scale
  • Set and enforce product standards: discovery rigour, technical specs, evaluation criteria, deployment quality
  • Run a disciplined product lifecycle: hypothesis → MVP → field evaluation → iteration → scale
  • Ensure timely, high-quality delivery against grant commitments and donor milestones
  • Team Leadership
  • Build and lead the product organisation — recruit, mentor, and grow product talent across geographies
  • Foster a strong product culture: user-obsessed, evidence-driven, technically rigorous
  • Partner closely with the Technology team on engineering capacity, infrastructure, and ML delivery
  • External Engagement
  • Represent WAIG's product capability in conversations with governments (Ministry of ICT Rwanda, Smart Africa, ministries of health and education across Africa), multilateral institutions (UNICEF, UNDP, World Bank), and donors (Gates Foundation, others)
  • Lead product portions of major proposals and donor pitches; contribute to fundraising in partnership with the Growth lead
  • Build relationships with peer organisations, research labs, and AI-for-good ecosystems
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with senior leadership on overall organisational strategy and delivery commitments
  • Work with the Growth and Fundraising lead on pipeline shaping and proposal development
  • Support the broader leadership team in operationalising the WAIG strategy

What We Are Looking For

Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in AI product management
  • Track record of building and shipping AI/ML products at scale — in real-world deployment
  • contexts, not pure consumer or pure research
  • Direct experience working with governments on technology deployments
  • Experience working with or in Africa, the Global South, or comparable contexts strongly preferred

Capability

  • Strong technical depth — able to engage credibly with ML engineers, evaluate technical trade-offs, and shape solution architecture
  • Outstanding strategic and structured thinking — able to set priorities, kill the wrong projects, and drive focus
  • Excellent communicator — equally comfortable in a Minister's office, a donor pitch, a field site, and a code review
  • Strong people leader — has built and grown product teams in distributed, multi-geography settings

Disposition

  • Mission-aligned — genuinely motivated by AI for social impact, not just by the title or the geography
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, frequent travel, and the realities of working in emerging-market deployment contexts
  • High ownership; low ego; bias to action
